On the flip side the interest rates used to entice new users are now expiring.  Would use longer term while the benefits make sense versus the competition.

records.title: Reducing Savings Rate soon
records.text: The boosted savings rate is boosted by 1% until January 2025. I think once the rate loses its boost a lot of people will move their money elsewhere where they can get a more competitive rate

records.title: Sadly, no joint accounts
records.text: Really like this bank, however, the lack of joint accounts mean I could never use this bank as my main current account.

records.title: Good for 4x when travelling
records.text: Good for 4x when travelling. Pity the app doesn't let you split income from expenditure, but otherwise a good all-rounder. Rates need to be upped a bit, or I'll be shopping around again.

records.title: Not as great as I first thought..
records.text: Ive been with Chase since they first opened their digital bank in the UK. Brilliant experience at the start 1% cashback, 1% on current account balances and very close the BOE interest rate for demand savings.. roll on a couple of years, 1% cashback up to £15 a month, no interest on current account and now a hefty 1.5% spread on demand savings from February.. Sadly it might be time for me to shop around!

records.title: The app works OK once you get used to…
records.text: The app works OK once you get used to it. Online help is quite good. But I cannot download last 60 or 90 day statements, and the between two dates option does not work. And so far i have been unable to download any statements in CSV format - only PDF which is not helpful for using in other software such as excel

records.title: Not as good as it sounds putting £1500…
records.text: Not as good as it sounds putting £1500 a month in to account is hard as a pensioner

records.title: Been with Chase now for almost a year
records.text: Been with Chase now for almost a year. It's a good bank for day to day transactions but it is a nightmare if you want to move money to investment accounts. Once a month i have to call up to unblock transfers to a number of savings and investment accounts because they always flag it as possible fraud, even if you have sent money to those accounts many times before. It is a slow laborious process of calling in, justifying what the payment is for, answering loads of questions and almost having to beg to have your funds transferred to an account you own. I understand the need but when it is to the same account used all the time it can be really annoying.

records.title: One big drawback…
records.text: Generally Chase accounts work really except for one very big niggle.  The inability to download statements/ transactions in csv format. Standard functionality these days.   Everything else about the Chase account is positive but this lack of functionality means I stopped using it.  I have raised this a number of times with Chase support but only get the answer “we have passed it on to the relevant team…..”

records.title: Need computer access, not just phone…
records.text: Generally seems to offer reasonable banking, but the big downfall is can not use computer so can't prepare accounts without major problem.Security wise a phone is probably the least secure of all banking. Just think of the number of mobiles stolen in London.

records.title: Poor new rebate policy
records.text: In general, the apps and the service are entirely good. But I have downgraded this bank because the new rebate scheme is so annoying. If you do not want to carry on the rebate, please do not necessarily ask to deposit £1500 into the apps.  Not client-centered.  I suggest you refer to the client’s monthly expenses to decide whether your client is loyal to using your bank and the amount of expenses. Poor customer service and marketing practices. Not in a smart way.

records.title: The app is very good & customer service excellent…
records.text: The app is very good & customer service when required is swift . Lower score because having grabbed the UK market with good interest rates, their savings rate is well below current market leaders & they are hoping people can't be bothered to change.

records.title: Been using 2 years now
records.text: Been using 2 years now. It used to be amazing comapred to other banks but now it's very average. Savings rates can be easily beaten even at main stream banks, time and items limited 1% cashback is probably the only reason why I'm still using it but you can get way more back using stoozing. So 3/5.

records.title: It's great for some, spending over £1500p/mnth
records.text: It's a great account for overseas use and has excellent little perks with its savings plans. However, as a pensioner, I no longer can guarantee a spend of £1500 per month so I will rarely qualify for cashback (£1500 min). I also noticed that a friend was given a higher rate on their savings account than I was, so Chase savings rates are selective!For some working people it's 5*, but for most pensioners it's 3*.

records.title: Poor changes
records.text: The bank is evolving for the good of the bank only..Promised to take cash, never happened said they would do CHAPS never happened, all they have done is to have non competitive interest rates, deposit £1500 a month etc.

records.title: seems ok as a secondary bank wouldnt…
records.text: seems ok as a secondary bank wouldnt trust it as a wealth manager or for anything complicated

records.title: Move Your Savings
records.text: Some good points, quick notification of spending, reasonable app, but the interest rate on savings has gone way down and is totally non competitive. Chase obviously don't want your money anymore, so move it somewhere that does and will reward you properly. Chase up your game and offer market leading rates again.

records.title: I want to use open banking
records.text: I want to use open banking with my Banktivity accounting programme but it won't work with chase because I have my chase app on an android phone!!Why??

records.title: Requesting TOO MUCH personal data
records.text: In the last few months, Chase have started insisting on a raft of personal information, with the threat of reducing making my access on the APP. Now, I have used Chase for quite a few years, and was happy with the APP, the customers service and the savings rates. However, despite being significantly in credit, some months back they began insisting on my supplying a raft of personal AND business data (this is a personal account, not a business account) - far beyond what any other bank I have used has requested (I have opened accounts with a good selection). My concerns are for my personal data protection, re security and 'misuse'. UPDATE: Re Chase reply to speak to their team: I have repeatedly spoke to their team, whose response amounts to  'The computer says no'.

records.title: Income irrelevant when not borrowing
records.text: The app works ok. The interest rate on savings is ok. However I removed all of  my savings once they threatened to reduce my capability, within the app, to my money. The reason for the threat was because I refused to provide an income level. They don't need this information to operate a debit card or savings account. The reason they want it is to better feed me suggestions for products. I don't want more products. I could have lied on the income level but I wasn't comfortable doing that. Therefore, to maintain my full access to my funds, I withdrew all bar pennies! ...shame really.In reply to Chase response to my initial feedback above:-They didn't deny my claim. They do not need your income but if you don't provide it then they will restrict the use of their app. ...Once again, all they want to do is send you more products ideas. I presume that I could lie (whichever way I prefer) but I'm not comfortable to do that. FYI I have had discussions with Chase on this and I'm afraid that, ultimately, "computer says no!".

records.title: Card used in another country
records.text: I gave this because my Chase account was used to buy food in another country I visited like 3 weeks prior and I didn’t feel protected by the system. I called the Chase people but nothing was solved. Right now I am scare to feed my Chase card incase I might lose more money without tress.

records.title: Agree with some of the reviews about…
records.text: Agree with some of the reviews about paying money out they are over zealous in protecting themselves from fraud and it's painful for example to pay off a loan with savings. They don't offer a joint account or credit card and these are a given that you would expect them. The app is great however and the saving rates are good.

records.title: Interest rates on savings account now…
records.text: Interest rates on savings account now not market leading, no interest on current account anymore and cashback capped at £25 per month. All of these things have happened in the last year or so, so have moved my savings elsewhere now.

records.title: Good experience but few benefits
records.text: The banking experience is good and customer service people on the app have been very helpful. However there are very few reasons to choose this bank over any other, as savings rates are very uncompetitive now, while the 1% spending cashback can be obtained elsewhere without jumping throigh so many hoops.

records.title: Not different to competitors.
records.text: Whilst a good bank and easy to use the app the rate of interest has continued to decrease ( greater than the fall in base rate). This is more than other banks. Now Chase does not distinguish itself from other banks and no longer beneficial to me. I have other bankers that offer more and better.

records.title: interest rate
records.text: Initially interest rates were market leading, latest announcement render Chase non competitive. Typical business model of get your business then exploit.

records.title: Don’t bother if you want a dynamic and…
records.text: Don’t bother if you want a dynamic and customer facing bank - making a transfer for the first time can be a nightmare, even worse if they ask you to call customer services. They simply read scripts, several times over, even when you provide all the information they ask for. They hide behind the excuse of safeguarding your money, but really it’s about protecting themselves from being sued. A complaint was not upheld, even though the agent admitted that mine was by no means the only one relating to their refusal, basically, to allow me to access my own money and send some to someone I trust. Perhaps they should start listening to the customer?

records.title: Existing customers are second best.
records.text: Great to be a new customer but Chase  stealthily reduce and reign in the initial benefits to become the same or slightly worse than other banks. Good start but  failed to sustain me as a valued customer. Disappointing customer experience.

records.title: There is so much to like about Chase but...
records.text: There is so much to like about Chase current account but there is one element which is awful and has caused issues for me. They, like every bank, have a system to identify potential fraud on your account. The issue is that even when they check with you that a payment is genuine and you tell them payments to company "X" are fine, they continue to reject them.

records.title: They won't let you spend your own…
records.text: They won't let you spend your own money.Crappy computer systems used in Philipines always going down they just tell you to ring them later on even when you've lost your bank card!!!!!This isn't a proper bank unless you take their interest because they don't consider us at all. Maybe they are related to Santander another joke bank?

records.title: To eager to block payments to shops etc…
records.text: To eager to block payments to shops etc without contacting me to find out if it was me that was spending on my Chase card. To eager to protect themselves what about the embarrassment it causes clients got refused in Starbucks for just over £12:00 Chase didn’t make contact I had to call them. Case still not resolved.

records.title: Strange Hi I received an e-mail telling me that…
records.text: Hi I received an e-mail telling me that I had to upgrade my account. I went to the link to upgrade and as much as I tried it would not let me do it.I then rang Chase and spoke to an assistant who tried to help me her name was Rona as I went through trying to get into my account. I was not happy with the questions asked to get into my account.  I was not happy so I rang the fraud line on 159 to find out if everything was ok with my account, when the phone was answered it was answered by the same assistant I had just spoke to Rona.

records.title: Until two days ago I was a huge fan of…
records.text: Until two days ago I was a huge fan of Chase bank but yesterday they ruined my Xmas shopping by blocking every transaction I wanted to make, and today they rejected a refund payment into my account (!) claiming it was the retailer who didn’t process the refund correctly - well I banked seventeen years with a different bank and this never happened so somehow I don’t believe it’s retailers fault .. they used to be awesome but clearly no longer care. What a pity.

records.title: Unfair Interest Rate change
records.text: Discovered my son in  Law has a better interest rate than we do . Told its because of the total monies in our account we were not offered the additional percentage  increase. Now removed money to ensure next time we get the offer. Chase lost our business

description: Taxes as they should be done.

records.title: Quick & Easy- Well Worth it.
records.text: Quickly assigned someone after few general Questions to register. Further details confirmed by messages with Accountant assigned to me. Quickly replied to questions & info provided. Will use again. Thank You. RK

records.title: This was the first year I had to submit…
records.text: This was the first year I had to submit a self assesment as I had always previously been.on PAYE. I was allocated Hakim as my accountant and he made the whole process as smooth and effortless as could be. I ended up paying very much less tax than I had calculated on my own with no payments on account required. Couldn't praise Tax Scouts more highly, super fast and efficient they privided great peace of mind. Mark

records.title: Effortless, Fantastic, and Genuine – Thanks to Bozena!
records.text: My experience with TaxScouts was absolutely exceptional, and a huge part of that was thanks to Bozena. She was amazing—always so prompt in her responses and incredibly kind in her words. Her thoughtful approach and expertise made the entire process feel even easier and stress-free.The process itself was incredibly straightforward, and the team’s professionalism stood out at every step. On top of that, the pricing was genuine and transparent, offering great value for the service provided.TaxScouts is doing a fantastic job of simplifying a typically complex task, and with team members like Bozena, they truly go above and beyond to deliver a fantastic experience. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a smooth and reliable tax solution!

records.title: Excellent tax assistance
records.text: Brian Molyneux was excellent, prompt and highly efficient. He managed my tax assessment and the related problems with ease. Provided helpful timely assistance and advice. I would highly recommend him and TaxScouts.

records.title: Jo my accountant is excellent she is…
records.text: Jo my accountant is excellent she is quick , efficient and very thorough and I would highly recommend tax scouts to anyone. I am completely useless at doing my books and always have been but its been a lot easier than I thought

records.title: Always give great service
records.text: Always give a great service and so prompt to sorting my tax return out, saves all the hassle of trying to do it yourself

records.title: Amazing
records.text: Amazing. Just when I thought it couldn’t get any better you pull it out the bag! Astonishingly quick, efficient and helpful. What amazing service and worth every penny.

records.title: Great service and so quick
records.text: Great service and so quick. No messing and cheaper than the competition. Called within a day of submitting to go through a few things and complete a few days later and filed.

records.title: An excellent service
records.text: An excellent service, which sorted me out after panicking over mistakes that I'd made in my Tax Return. I was reassured that everything would be sorted out, and Imran - my assigned accountant - was calm and efficient throughout. A lesson for the future - use someone who knows what they're doing - and I would use Tax Scouts again.

records.title: My Accountant Faruk Ahmed is…
records.text: My Accountant Faruk Ahmed is professional, efficient and responds very quickly to all my queries.  I would recommend him to anyone looking for a good Tax Accountant

records.title: Good but could have been better
records.text: I have used Tax Scouts before. Again the questions for my tax return were easy to complete and the draft was received within a week. However I forgot to include charity donations which weren't a great deal but asked for that to be included. I heard nothing more from my account and after waiting over two weeks for the inclusion I just approved the tax return. Had that not been the case I would have rated 5. stars.

records.title: Prompt action— queries raised by them…
records.text: Prompt action— queries raised by them quickly and dealt with by same accountant throughout. Not happy that as a returning customer I was charged more than a new customer gets charged also discounts given to other customers after I had paid full fee 😡

records.title: Great
records.text: Self Assessment was miscalculated at first because the payments on account were not included. Not the accountants fault, I think this should be asked in the initial document stage.Second opinion and saves you filling out HMRCs god awful form too.

records.title: This is the first time I have used this…
records.text: This is the first time I have used this method for getting my self assessment completed and found it relatively easy to navigate with a little practice I did think on times that the communication between us was a bit lacking regarding response however we got there in the end ..to sum up I will use them again also I would certainly recommend them

records.title: Professional
records.text: Professional. I would have appreciated quicker responses. I was surprised that there was a reduction in almost 50 percent in what I owe HMRC but only after I asked for more detail. I think I should have been asked what my current tax codes were.

records.title: Thank you very much I know it was a…
records.text: Thank you very much I know it was a nightmare getting my tax return because of the mix up that HMRC had made but much appreciated what you have done.

records.title: It was good although would have liked…
records.text: It was good although would have liked the tax consultant to be a bit more proactive as was not overly impressed when I asked a question of heating etc parts of the business I did the ground work first. Would expect more proactivity for claims next tax cycle or could I please be assigned to another tax consultant?  Thank you.

records.title: In Safe hands with Rooh
records.text: Used Tax Scouts for  two years now with Rooh Shah and he has been brilliant works tirelessly and always answers questions very efficiently even at weekends, really recommend him and Tax Scouts very highly takes all the stress of tax returns out of the window. Just brilliant.

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service which saved me £1000 in taxes. The only slightly annoying thing was I submitted highlighted bank statements as it was an option to do so. After printing and separating the income and expenses, I was then asked to provide a spreadsheet so ended up wasting time. If bank statements are not allowed it shouldn’t be there as an option.

records.title: Helpful if unsure of tax returns
records.text: Thought the advisor i had was really knowledgable and helpful, process was easy to follow, just the occasional comms gap that would have made it 5 stars! Would recommend though and do it again, i chose the full package at £249 and thought this was worth it

records.title: Very very good
records.text: Totally fantastic service from start to finish, I don't know how you can improve your service, leave as is!The only reason for 4 star review instead of 5 is you have charged me £169 for the service but I see it advertised everywhere for £149, why was I charged £20 more?

records.title: Speedy accurate service
records.text: Would have given 5 stars but for a bit of a problem sorting my ID (which may well have been partly from my lack of understanding of what was needed!). I did find it a little daunting sending such sensitive information online to an organisation that I didn't know, but the response from Tax Scouts was fast and helpful, and my accountant Izzi is amazing. Once my ID was sorted my return was completed, filed and paid in 24 hrs. I will certainly be using this service in the future! Thank you

records.title: Good, just not as good as I had hoped
records.text: Website and data entry are very clear and easy to use. Service connects you to external accountants who are very responsive to messages and thorough and clear in how they deal with you. Whole process was around a week, including my own response times. Why not 5*? Final calculation from HMRC was higher than the accountant calculation. Was still lower than the previous year and my own, inaccurate calculation. The service still represents good value for money.

records.title: Tax Return
records.text: The accountant who prepared my return at record speed was fantastic and I'm pleased to say I've had the same person two years in a row so its great to have that continuity. I had a bit of trouble finding my way around the system at first but once I worked out what was needed it was all plain sailing. Thank you!

records.title: I’ve used these two years in a row…
records.text: I’ve used these two years in a row can’t fault them they make it easy doing a return but can wait a while for a reply when trying chase something up

records.title: Good but could be improved
records.text: Quick and easy to use. Felt a lack of clarity and information on how the calculations were done. Seemed that my own QB calculations were simply cut and pasted with no account made to me of why the figures were used and what the implications were.

records.title: Very Professional
records.text: I admit that I left my Tax return until the last possible minute, and didn't have all the relevant information. Even so, Karen helped me through it all, and was very patient and professional, and provided help in getting the Tax Return complete. I will definitely use Tax Scouts in future.

records.title: Accountant was very patient with me and…
records.text: Accountant was very patient with me and explained everything as I didn't know most to the things to do with filling my tax returns and corporate tax

records.title: Really great experience
records.text: Really great experience. Although the initial account that was assigned to the task suddenly fell ill, Tax Scouts very super quick to react and assign a new accountant who could complete the task without much extra information.My tax return involved overseas/foreign tax residency which I initially thought would make it more difficult but the process was smooth and easy.

records.title: Time saver…. Just not advice
records.text: Service was fine, they filed my accounts as expected. I misunderstood the service though as I was hoping for some advice on savings, instead of just an accountant submitting the form on behalf. If you are after a time saver then this is a great service, however if you want some advice, it costs extra so factor that in.

records.title: So many bad reviews
records.text: I have always heard positive information regarding this company. However, after reading the reviews I feel like I will have to find an alternative. So many bad reviews.

records.title: Great and efficient but I did wonder…
records.text: Great and efficient but I did wonder why the accountant has not responded to my message post submitting my self-assessment.I wonder whether the "job" is closed down as soon as a submission is made into HMRC? Shame as I still have some outstanding questions which remain unanswered

records.title: User friendly but needs careful checking
records.text: User friendly, convenient platform, and I find it helpful to help give a bit of structure to working through my return. For the second year now though, there have been significant errors in the first return prepared so make sure you really check the calculations carefully.

records.title: Not bad, but not outstanding
records.text: No sure. I think Taxscouts itself is fine, but the experience depends of the accountant allocated to you (you can't pick one).When I submitted all documents (properly labelled), the accountant missed some, and didn't take in account my SIPP contributions. Luckily I have double-checked.Then, I have to tell him every tax relief I can apply for. And explain why I should applying for it.Should it be the opposite ? The accountant should propose me solution to optimize my taxes.The accountant was replying me between 2AM and 4AM. Not sure he works in the UK or from abroad. That also questions if my data also goes abroad ... When the accountant wasn't replying to my question, after a week (instead of 48h), the customer service of Taxscouts helped me to get a reply. That is positive.I will probably try again next year Taxscouts, with another accountant or the same (not sure how it works), then update this review.

records.title: Very bad communication
records.text: Very bad communication. The tax return has been prepared within 2 days, which is fine, but all subsequent questions were simply ignored by the accountant. Just silence. 48 hours SLA is not a thing.Even more strange is that when they submitted the return, it is still shown as due in my HMRC account. I believe accountant is not going to comment that at all again.

records.title: Ok but very transactional
records.text: Easy to use system, entirely virtual and transactional. Did not find the interaction with analyst very friendly and response time was often very slow.

records.title: Great concept, but incompetent accountant..shame!
records.text: System very easy to use and upload data to, but problem was, the allocated accountant ignored all my uploaded data and kept sending me 'updated tax returns' that were simply filled with random rubbish data from I know not where.  I suspect this system only works if you get a good accountant... clearly, I didn't.  Shame,, but there you have it.  So many good reviews - but it only takes one bad apple....!!Since writing this review, Tax Scouts have appointed a new accountant for me, so here's hoping things may improve.   However, as a result of the swift, positive, and supportive actions, I will now give Tax Scouts 3 stars.

records.title: Try it with a pinch of salt!
records.text: Good: The accountant assigned to me was prompt in his response (all online) and return was prepared in 48 hours, after a few comments to and fro. My main reason for using Tax Scouts is to discuss and file payroll rebate I got. The reasons for 3 stars (not 5) are:1) The software used behind the scenes doesn't cater to Payroll rebates. 2) No SA302 Tac calculation is provided, which is required for Mortgage purposes. I always got it from previous accountants. 3) No telephone support, sometimes it is easier to quickly discuss over phone than to type and explain, which happened in my case re. payroll rebates. It took 3 revision to get the return right.

records.title: Very slow process
records.text: Was very slow, took about 2 months to get it completed with endless chasing. The platform was easy to understand to upload everything and the return itself was done correctly but with the amount of time it took it would have been simpler to do it myself!

records.title: Efficient service, communication could be better
records.text: The service was very efficient, which I found extremely helpful. As it was my first time using tax scouts and I was also experiencing problems with my laptop the flow of the communication was not the best, which I take full responsibility for. On a couple of occasions I apologised and thanked my accountant for their time and patience and at no time at all did I receive any acknowledgment of my apologies. This for me is basic courtesy and that is the only reason I have not scored you a 5. I will be using you in the future but with all due respect would prefer a different accountant.

records.title: Quick responses, but wrong tax figure!
records.text: Quick response, however certain errors on tax return and initial tax due quoted gave me a heart attack. Was far higher than the correct value which I had to inform the accountant to correct upon reviewing...I shouldn't have to be telling the accountant what to do. Have been using tax scouts for 3 years now and usually been fine. Accountant easy to communicate with and quick to respond to queries.

records.title: Given up with Tax Scouts
records.text: Given up with Tax Scouts, three emails over a month or so and no response at all. Time is running short so need to look elsewhere.

records.title: Let down at first, but better by the end
records.text: I was really let down by the first accountant you cancelled our appointment 5 minutes before the call and didn't bother responding to messages thereafter. When the appointment was finally rebooked, i was sent 2 video links, one for Microsoft teams and one for Zoom, I joined both calls simultanously, as no response to message asking which the correct link was, and again the accountant, Ryan Witter didn't show.When I contacted customer support, the agent seemed pretty inexperienced, and pointed to me perhaps being confused about the time? But in fairness did their best trying to help connect me with another accountant.Once I had the appointment with the new accountant, Robert Couser, the process was incredibly swift and smooth, and Robert's communication was fast and simple. So a mixed bag, but the ease of the service in the end with Robert's support was brilliant.

records.title: Good but use with caution…
records.text: This was a good find as I needed help with one aspect of my tax return, and the price was competitive. However, you need to be very careful - my accountant did not claim something I requested, saying it was not allowed, but a basic search supported my position and I had to point this out. If I had not known, pressed, and provided evidence from the GOV.uk website, I would have ended up owing hundreds in tax. A fairly fundamental error which undermined my confidence in the accountant.

records.title: Glad it's done
records.text: I liked how simple it was to fill in the forms.I liked how friendly Beth my accountant was, even though I'm clueless she seemed to be patient with me gathering the information she needed.I disliked that I recieved my initial message from Beth via the website but I didn't get an email notification so nearly a week went by without me realising that she'd been in contact.But my biggest gripe is that when signing up I was given an estimate of my refund that was exponentially different from the final outcome, like selling me a meal cooked by Gordon Ramsey, then bringing out a microwave mac n cheese from poundland. Estimating a refund of around £1000 then getting a £98 refund is RIDICULOUS! just don't give an estimate if you can't semi accurately give one.

records.title: Very fast but clearly some errors with my latest tax return
records.text: Have used Tax Scouts before and found them very reliable and fast. They also allocated the same accountant to me.  Unfortunately this time they didn’t do a good job at all and have miscalculated my tax which left me owing to HMRC. Very disappointed at the scale of miscalculation.

records.title: Was pretty stop on at first told me my…
records.text: Was pretty stop on at first told me my payment would only take a few days I’m still waiting after about 3 weeks sent multiple of messages an had no response

records.title: I find that the accountant (s) that I…
records.text: I find that the accountant (s) that I have are not at all personable or eager to go help beyond the absolute basics. It’s a great platform to get your tax return sorted quickly without the faff of going into doing it yourself - but I would appreciate a little more support from an human involved!

records.title: I found your response time slower than…
records.text: I found your response time slower than last year and less personalised. Difficulties have been bounced back to me in a rather offhand manner and I haven't felt valued as a client.

records.title: Sold out - otherwise happy but moving
records.text: I was happy and still am with the service but I invested in what I thought was a good company for small businesses, you've sold out and small investers are getting nothing so I'll move to another small company

records.title: Easy to use but incorrect tax caculations
records.text: The platform is very easy to use and customer service is quite responsive. However, the advisor I was paired with was not very proactive and didn't really respond to my questions. For the second year he only asked for one document, and I had to push three times for him to accept additional documentation. Following that my tax bill was reduced by £2.5k compared to his initial assessment! I then contacted customer service request a new accountant as I was really worried that whatever he had done was not correct (given his initial assessment was so wrong). They refused to provide a new accountant on the basis that "he was still answering my messages". I then decided to leave them and now looking for a new accountant. At least they have provided a refund fee.

records.title: Beware
records.text: EDIT: AFTER POSTING THIS REVIEW I WAS CALLED AND REFUNDED 100%. Thanks TaxScounts. Beware.  Reviews must be fake.  Daylight robbery, I paid for a Capital Gains return and consultation but they weren't able to file the return.  The consultation was 5 minutes as no more was necessary, the accountant was knowledgeable but added no useful information from what's FREE on HMRC website.  I'm only being refunded £110, so effectively paying £140 for information that is available for free, and I've wasted 2 hours of my life.  The return could be filed by now.

records.title: Scary
records.text: My tax affairs are straightforward.  Somehow it took over 6 weeks to complete and I found the whole process really stressful. I don’t have much confidence in the process, the platform or the service.  Some fundamental things were missed and if I had not spotted them I don’t sense there is any oversight to otherwise pick these things up. The business is a good idea in a sector crying out for change, but it all feels like too many corners have been cut. I’d rather pay more for better. Given the high stakes, you need to have confidence in anyone handling your information and completing your tax return, and unfortunately I did not. Scary.

records.title: Serious mistakes on return
records.text: The platform is intuitive and easy to use. He was very friendly and responsive, but if I hasnt checked the return carefully twice over, I'd have filed a very inaccurate return to HMRC.

records.title: Two expensive errors
records.text: This looked a great option for me.  Unfortunately my accountant made a significant error in his first draft.  This meant my bill was several thousand more than I expected.  i spotted the error and returned it.  My accountant did not come back to me within the agreed  time frames and I had to raise a complaint to have this addressed.The next draft looked correct and it was submitted.  HMRC came back to say that my Scottish base had not been taken into account and the bill was recalculated and I was several thousand pound worse off.  I complained and to be fair my fee was refunded.  However, both these errors should not have happened.  It is important to double check what you get back and ensure your location is correct...particularly if you are in Scotland.

I also questioned how much attention had been given to the documents I had provided as my initial calculations were closer than my accountant's by nearly 50% because he hadn't read the report I had sent him. records.title: Misleading "Get Paid Early" Feature - They Hold Your Money!
records.text: I’ve been using Monzo for a while, but I recently discovered that their "Get Paid Early" feature isn’t the benefit it claims to be. Payments that are supposed to arrive on Monday (e.g., student finance or salary) are held by Monzo until the last possible release date, and then they release the funds at 4 PM on the previous working day (Friday in this case).What’s frustrating is that other banks release the same payments much earlier—on Friday morning—without claiming it’s a "special feature." Monzo is effectively holding onto my money longer than necessary, likely for their own financial benefit, while making it look like they’re doing me a favor.If you’re considering Monzo for this so-called "benefit," think twice. Other banks are faster and more transparent. I’m seriously questioning their ethics and considering switching to a bank that doesn’t play these games with my money.

When I explained this to Salary Finance, the initial offer they made me for an adjusted payment amount was simply not feasible which I explained to them. They then stopped responding to me altogether. I regularly contacted to try to come to an agreement that worked but no one ever responded and now, even though I was contacting salary finance to come to an agreement, I have been passed on to a third-party debt collector.

records.title: Great to begin with, then left out on the cold.
records.text: In the setting up of my Trust Deed, the team were super helpful and eager to get my deed sorted. Once signing the agreement, the level of service dropped. I signed my agreement back in May and it is still not approved despite one of their team members saying "The objection date has now passed ad no creditors can object, you will receive a call this week." This was over a month ago and I have called three times since and today they told me that in fact, a creditor did object. I have been passed from pillar to post for over 2 months and no one takes responsibility.There is no timeline for the creditor to object however I must continue to send payments to them despite the creditors not actually agreeing to the Trust Deed. When I call, I am put on hold and given another excuse. Not a single email from them after I signed other than their payment details. I have sent 3 emails requesting the status of my Trust Deed and have had no response. I did have high hopes for them and I do hope this can be resolved. Given the severity of the situation, you would think that request updates would be provided rather than me having to call every other day.I sent a few texts to the lovely person who onboarded me and after I was signed up, I never heard from her again. In short, I do hope this can be resolved instead of continually being passed from pillar to post. I do feel that there is a lack of customer care post signing your agreement. If the Trust Deed is approved, I would recommend them as they do set up the process, however, for 3 months, I have been in financial limbo which adds to your stress.I do hope in raising this complaint, that the team do take my case more seriously.

So now I have both credit amounts on my credit card so can’t close it till my refund is processed!  I have a loan account with Zopa so asked for the credit card overpayment to be credited to my loan account. They can’t do this which surprised me in this day and age. records.text: Great little banking app.  I can move money about quickly and easily.  Zopa annoys me by offering me a credit card firstly with a 4k limit then taking away the offer simply because I changed my address.  My financial circumstances remained constant.  They offered me a credit card again a month later with a reduced limit then withdrew the offer 3 days later. My credit score is around 850 / 999. Fed up with waiting so took out a John Lewis credit card  -  simple , straightforward application and acceptance.  I've also removed 5k of savings with zopa and placed into a Barclays rainy day savings account with instant access and 5% interest  . Zopa, you are handy but could do better.

records.title: I was invited to open a beta current…

records.title: Honest review from former customer

records.title: Terrible customer service

I only wanted a statement.Then I was told to email their security department with a copy of my passport.I will certainly not use Zopa again.

records.title: Timewasting feature of the car finance.
records.text: I have a Credit card with them which in fairness isn't too bad.The reason for the two stars is Car Finance.They state what is required for this but what they do is very misleading and actually a massive timewaste also done maliciously too as not many of the other car finance companies do this.If you search and provide a car that is more than 10 years old - they will say to call them to speak about it - upon speaking to them I am told they can't provide finance for any car at all over 10 years.Why not make the website state this like every other site.Not acceptable.

records.title: Was brilliant - now impossible to access

records.title: Quick to start up and app is OK to use
records.text: Quick to start up and app is OK to use. However if you have problems with a pin number don't bother calling Zopa as you have to rest your card over 24 hours and can only get a new pin through some cashpoint machines. description: TSB is a retail bank with a trusted customer brand, heritage stretching back to the start of the savings bank movement 200 years ago, and a committed workforce that offer full service banking to more than five million customers. We operate on a modern banking platform and serve our customers through digital channels, over the phone and in branches across the UK.

records.title: Fantastic service both on line and in…
records.text: Fantastic service both on line and in person. Great Bank with great customer service. Needed to stop a fraudulent payment on my account. records.title: Easy and fast loan application process
records.text: I could not believe how easy it was to apply for my loan, as an existing customer I did expect a faster process but it was all done in less than 10mins including approval! The money was in my account the next day and I applied on a Sunday. Well done TSB👏

records.title: Very helpful lady in my local branch

I felt so much better afterwards so a very big thank you Caroline

records.title: Had a re-mortgage meeting with Kirtika…
records.text: Had a re-mortgage meeting with Kirtika at Barclays who went through everything in a clear and consice manner. Stress free from start to finish. Could not recommend enough. If only all employees were like Kirtika.

records.title: Very helpful young lady
records.text: While visiting my TSB branch in Plymouth, a young lady by the name of Caitlin was extremely helpful to me with my query's, as she has been at other times. Thank Caitlin it was very much appreciated, your patience and understanding meant a lot.

records.title: Easy Banking
records.text: I have had my account with TSB since I was 16 years old. I am now 65 years old and still have the same account, so they must be doing it right. It's easy to remember when anyone fails to do something correctly but 99% of the time their system suits my lifestyle.

records.title: Best top Bank in United Kingdom always…
records.text: Best top Bank in United Kingdom always been great services help struggling peoples I been many years with bank very helpful lovely staff

records.title: Extremely helpful
records.text: I would just like to say my brother and I came into the Grimsby branch between Christmas and New Year, we were seen by Kevin Wardle who was very professional, kind and compassionate when dealing with our late mums account.

records.title: TSB Experience
records.text: The whole TSB process for my mortgage was painless from start to finish. Their representative set up a Zoom Meeting and all was explained methodically and slowly so I could consider my options. The follow-up contact was punctual and as promised. I cannot rate TSB Mortgage department more highly!

records.title: Very helpful staff members
records.text: I was having great difficulty with online banking when trying to make a time-sensitive arrangement. I had been booked in for a meeting on Friday, but the situation could not wait. I requested a phone-call and Rachel Allen from the Bolton branch (whom the appointment Friday was with) called me back promptly, and spent some time trying to fix my account so I could proceed online. Having fixed the issues, I no longer needed to wait five days to make the arrangement, and could proceed myself simply and quickly. I have high praise for all of her help.  I would like to add that having been with TSB for some time, the online banking services are far behind other banks, but it's more than made up for by the call centre staff. Virtually no wait times, and always very helpful and pleasant.

At the end I was very happy with it as I promptly repaid it thanks to good investment advice and now I am debt free. I want to thank the bank for giving me the loan. records.title: My account

records.title: Once I eventually long waiting time got through around 20…

records.title: Easy

records.title: Getting the important things done when it is busy
records.text: Even though it has been a busy time with the move not running smoothly, I really appreciated that my mortgage advisor, Pius, followed up with me to make sure I had put appropriate Home Contents, Life Insurance and Critical Illness Cover in place for my new flat and mortgage. When there are so many things to set up and get done, it is easy to forget these things. records.title: Happy with the service that I received…

records.title: Colin Edwards

records.title: My Savings Account moving issues:

records.title: Feedback and improvement opportunities

records.title: Personal loan

Finally gave up after waiting what seemed like an age. Have now managed to sort out my problem on my own. In the past I would go to the Winslow TSB Bank and talk to someone. records.title: Dealing with a blocked card

records.title: Branch service declined significantly
records.text: Unfortunately, after 11 years of being very happy with the Aberystwyth TSB branch, I can no longer offer a more than 2 stars review. Whereas before they offered competitive services or rates, they are no longer standing out from the rest of the banks - or rather, in some areas they stand out by performing worse.Firstly, they no longer offer in-branch mortgage service. I spoke to an advisor in central office on the phone, who was very polite and promised a call back - but noone phoned me. The counter windows are permanently covered with blinds nowadays which gives off an impression that the branch is in the process of being closed. I ended up taking my (re)mortgage business elsewhere.Secondly, unlike other banks who offer an alternative use of an authentication device that looks like a calculator, TSB only allow you to log in if you have a working mobile phone. A deal breaker for those living in rural areas where the signal is patchy, or that, most recently, had no mobile service for a whole week due to storms.And thirdly, I had some old-style pound coins that came from my washing machine. They were dented and battered, so I came into the branch to ask staff if they'd exchange them for new coins, and the advisor said they would, but they've already closed the vault, so I needed to come back another day. When I came in on another day, another advisor was adamant that the coins were "fake". It was a very poor choice of words; the coins were obviously real just really battered, and he had no means of telling that they were "fake". If anything, he coud have said: "I'm sorry, I can't be certain that they are real". So again, I took them to another bank, who changed them without any questions asked. TSB have just lost a loyal customer because of £2.I'll be sticking around with TSB until a switch deal comes along for another bank, but unfortunately, its days of being a competitive customer focused business that I valued are gone.ADDED following TSB response: thanks very much, James. I will of course consider TSB again in the future when my mortgage comes up for renewal, and I hope this will give it enough time to impove the inbranch service. As I said, I couldn't fault the service up until Covid, with late opening hours, Saturdays service and mortgage advisor in branch. In the days when everything is on-line, it was a great incentive to remain with TSB even when a better financial products were available elsewhere.

records.title: Improved Communication and Reassurance from Debit Correct
records.text: ## Updated ReviewI initially had concerns about Debit Correct, but I want to acknowledge that they took proactive steps to address my questions. They reached out and explained everything in detail, demonstrating their commitment to resolving any doubts. The representative I spoke with was extremely helpful and even went the extra mile by sending me an email with direct contact information for future inquiries. This personal touch put my mind at ease. However, it would be beneficial to have an app or similar platform that allows me to track my payments, view my payment history, and monitor the remaining balance. Such a feature would greatly enhance the overall experience and transparency with Debit Correct.## Old ReviewI want to believe that Debit Correct is a legitimate company genuinely trying to assist its customers. However, my experience with them has raised doubts in my mind. Despite being assured of a welcome call, I never received one. Additionally, during their checks on me, they unexpectedly requested the numbers of my credit cards, which took me by surprise as this information was not mentioned when I signed the contract. The sudden closure of my credit accounts came as an unwelcome shock. What exacerbates the situation is the lack of transparency regarding payment allocation and the visibility of my decreasing debt level. It's disheartening that I cannot track where my payments are going, and there is no way to independently verify the accuracy of their statements. To foster trust, it is crucial for Debit Correct to provide customers with clear information and access to monitor their progress.

records.title: It started well
records.text: It started well, via WhatsApp chat. Someone phoned me and went through a budget but had to end the call and said they would call a few days later - but didn’t. There was no response to the WhatsApp thread for three days so I had to email. A different person called to go through solutions, no apology for the breakdown in comms.  Unfortunately, the second advisor (after telling me the best option was a debt management plan) gave me fleeting examples of cost and kept asking whether I wanted to go ahead. When I hesitated and said I wasn’t sure as I needed to know what the monthly charge would be (not a rough estimate of £70 for the first 6 months), his reply was “what more do you need to know?!” Or to that effect. I was already stressed and anxious and then felt I was being pushed to make a decision without the proper information, and almost belittled as if I didn’t understand properly. I felt my vulnerability was being balanced on so I ended the call and phoned my bank directly. They were far kinder, more empathetic and are helping me to sort the debt without a monthly charge. I can’t say I would recommend this company at all.

records.title: So far it’s promising… but need more time to evaluate
records.text: After reading so many of the reviews on here, I can tell that a lot of it is advertisement for other (probably scammy services) and identify problems with this company that I myself have not faced. I took a gamble with the first deposit of roughly $27. Waited a day and tested a withdrawal. It worked so whoever mentions high deposits before you can get withdrawals, that has not been the case with me at all. I was able to withdraw the day after my first small deposit. Also one thing to note about withdrawals are the transfer fees. HashFactor makes the fee structure for each supported crypto very transparent on the withdrawal screen. Another thing worth noting is that low amount withdrawals (like $10-20) are a waste of money. Say you have $15 in your mining earnings, you need to account roughly $9-10 received after fees so for those low amounts you’re essentially wasting $5 each time which adds up if you do it often enough. My suggestion is to let it sit for a week before withdrawing. As far as withdrawals go, they make it seem like you can make 24/7 withdrawals (or maybe I understood their verbiage incorrectly) but in my case it’s one withdrawal per 24 hours. As far as constructive criticism goes, I do think that should be clarified better in the FAQs on the website.Any withdrawal I have made has arrived in my wallet within 20 minutes. It’s reasonable to expect it to take longer if the network is congested so don’t get discouraged if it takes longer. I simply keep track of my wallet number on MemPool and once I see the pending transfer, I just give it the time to confirm on the blockchain. It’s always came through. Another note is about their mining estimates. Once you purchase more speed, your mining estimates will change based on that. Given the volatility of crypto, expect those mining estimates to change as time goes on. Mine goes up some days, on others it goes down. Either way, the daily estimates have thus far been mostly accurate. I’d read reviews of others depositing but not getting their speed. That is one thing that really made me nervous at first. There’s a wallet to deposit to but what is that wallet and how does it ensure that my payment goes to the right account? Well, the answer is simple really. I have surmised that it is your own custom deposit wallet. So whatever you send to that wallet address will automatically post to your HashFactor account once it is confirmed on the blockchain. I’ve made roughly 4 different deposits totaling around $250 and each time I’ve gotten the speed I paid for using the wallet address they’ve given me within moments of confirming on the blockchain. So far the whole process has been fairly smooth. Like with all new crypto ventures I discover, I remain cautiously optimistic and begin with low investments until the company fully earns my trust. I’d like for this site to stick around for a while. There is real potential here. The best part about this site is that they make it so easy to understand everything (from my perspective) that you don’t have to know much about mining to know how much you’ll be making off of your investments. The hardest part is really learning about crypto wallets, transfer fees and all that jazz. If you know how to operate a crypto wallet, send/receive funds and can navigate a website, you can totally do HashFactor. Since this is a relatively new company, I advise being cautious about how much you invest. Don’t invest what you can’t afford to lose. It is tempting to drop your life savings into it but wait for the company to prove its longevity before making any huge deposits. I plan on investing more into HashFactor once I receive my full RoI. Since I am still new to all of this, I will report back in a few weeks with my thoughts up to that point. So far it seems very promising and has delivered on its promises so far but based on other reviewers on here it does make me skeptical about the long-term.

records.text: I have been with Kraken for many years and have even had a few issues in the past. With the help of their support team, the issues were resolved very quickly. Bull run + FOMO + KYC delays + Support backlog + issues being reported multiple times due to the backlog delays, has put Kraken on the back foot. The Kraken FUD is tangible online.Having worked in support for decades, I know such a combination of events can snowball quickly.Ticket # 11949060Although I have submitted all the KYC documentation, confirmed by the three green checkmarks on the "Get verified" page, I am still not verified. (2 months and counting). That in itself isn't too bad, but now I can't do anything with my account. I am stuck in a "Get verified" loop. "Get verified" page only has a "Sign out" option.Initially Cristian replied quickly, requesting me to sign in, unfortunately, although I had signed in multiple times as requested, I missed the instructions to mail back that I had done so. (Multiple emails later over the last week, still no reply.)The next day I started a chat. (#12011200) After one hour Daryl put me through to a specialist. Another 4 hours later and, even though I pinged them in the chat every 30-60 minutes, no one responded.Because I can't see anything in my account, I don't even know if my cases are still open.I have exactly the same is as user "PD" had here last week. After posting here, his issue was resolved quickly.Fingers crossed this works for me as well.@Kraken, some transparency on the "Get verified" page would go a long way.Update: After posting on KrakenSupport reddit, the issue was resolved within an hour.I wish the Kraken Support team all the best with their current challenges. :)

records.title: Lower Margin Level Showed on Kraken UI?
records.text: In spring of 2022 the Kraken user interface (UI) showed a lower margin level (%) than it should be. The margin level is important as it is preferred to stay above 100%. At < 100% you're is not able to open new spot positions on margin. At 40% or lower Kraken may liquidate your positions.According to Kraken it was experiencing a visual bug where the EUR/USD rate on the web UI was quoting a rate of 1.21. Due to this, users holding a EUR balance as collateral were experiencing a visual bug where they saw a higher equity, free margin and margin level.As far as we know, Kraken did not release a post regarding (the existence and resolution of) this bug.Did you also expercienced this bug, or are you still experiencing it? Check it by calculating your margin level (yML).To calculate your margin level (yML) you need to know your trade balance (TB), current valuation (CV), opening cost (OC) and leverage (L):  yML = (TB+(CV-OC))/(OC/L)*100.Compare your margin level (yML) with the margin level on your Kraken user interface and give us your feedback.PON

records.title: Does Kraken expose its users to an increased risk of being liquidated?
records.text: Over the past few months I have discovered some bugs in Krakens User Interface.One of the bugs concerns wrongly calculated Margin trade balance and hence wrong Margin level.This bug at Kraken let me to believe that my Margin trade balance, and my Margin level were higher than they were in reality. This is because the User Interface shows a higher Margin Trade Balance than the sum of my assets.  The sum of the assets must be the same as the Margin Trade Balance.However my user interface shows a Margin Trade Balance of 86.742,59 USD instead of 66.607,82 USD.Kraken’s interface shows a margin level of 136,85 % instead of the correct margin level of approx. 108%. This correct Margin Level is calculated according to krakens formulas;  ML = (TB+(CV-OC))/(OC/5)*100  (I can go into more depth about this if people are interested…)Assuming that Kraken uses the correct way to calculate Margin Level in their back log, this would mean my positions could be closer to liquidation level while my UI still shows healthy or less dangerous margin level. So in theory while the back log may have calculated a Margin Level of 40% or less (which will liquidate your position as this is the liquidation level), the UI may still have shown well above this threshold. This can negatively impact your decision making when it for example comes to adding more margin to your position or strategically liquidating your position before you hit critical levels.I wonder if Kraken did actually expose me, and other Kraken users, to an increased risk of being liquidated without our knowledge…

After 6 phone calls to support without resolution, I reluctantly sent my info anyway via e mail and got the above account closure e mail with NO EXPLANATION. I tried to talk to customer service and demanded to speak to a supervisor or manager. Told no one was available. description:
Tide is dedicated to supporting those who work for themselves. More than 300,000 small business owners have trusted Tide for their business current account. 
No monthly fee and account options that grow with your business. Access all your business finance admin needs in one place. Set up direct debits, categorise your transactions, and manage invoices all within the Tide app. Enjoy seamless integration with popular accounting software, including Sage, QuickBooks and Xero.
From company registration to managing your team's  expenses, Tide saves you time and helps you get back to doing what you love.
Join our community of business owners just like you. Apply online today to open a smart business current account in minutes.

records.title: A few things of concern for small businesses like myself.
records.text: I recently opted for tide business account, however after reading reviews around accounts being frozen for no reason and support lacking  it’s not something a small business like my own could survive for weeks with funds frozen. I think it’s similar to PayPal holding funds without reason, and it’s really worried me that there is no telephone option to speak to an actual person. I will say my experience so far 1st month has been very straightforward and way better than Starling etc, I cannot understand why it uses your personal name instead of your business name when paying and giving customers your details and customers asking if it’s Clearpay ? And not Tide it’s a little confusing in that department too.

records.title: Be prepared for frustrations
records.text: Easy to set up. Major issue I have, they have paused an incoming payment, then ask for details of the payee things such as communication, invoices etc etc. clearly said payment is from a Government dept but according to Tide this must look suspicious. Customer services don’t deal with this, their specialist team only communicates via the messaging service, once provided everything (which would not break GDPR/Data protection - which they seem to not worry about) I am still waiting. The chat ended with the worker saying if there was anything else to contact them, 3 messages later and still no response.

records.title: I chose 3 stars as I had a call back…
records.text: I chose 3 stars as I had a call back from these guys. The initial set up was wrong on every level, this is because of the lack of information put forward to potential customers. If took a little while but in the end it was sorted. However no compensation was offered for all the inconvenience that had been caused by the delay

records.title: Starling is way better in my opinion
records.text: Starling is way better in my opinion. Tide App always takes a while to open up, have to attempt a few times. Businesses get charged transaction fees. Despite having two directors, only one card is issued! A second spending card is available at a monthly cost and restricted to spending only. So my business partner can’t even fully access the account to make transfers for example.

records.title: I have used Tide for a year and has…
records.text: I have used Tide for a year and has been really good . But lately my customers using the pay link system the money doesn’t show up very quickly in the account.The customer service is very slow on response and not very responsive.It’s a shame because the app works very well most of the time .

records.title: Such a horrible experience
records.text: UPDATE 3 Stars: they fixed the issue and opened my account. The team was really helpful but I wish I didn’t need to write a bad review to get their attention. 1 Star: Applied for a business savings account and they told me I was going to hear back in 48 hours. After over 10 days of no communication I’ve contacted customer service. They asked one question and then disappeared completely on me. The application process was also absolutely terrible as their website glitched multiple times. I do not recommend them.

records.title: Great app but needs improvement
records.text: Tide has been a great application for me and the support team are great with their communication. However unfortunately the time it takes to fix some bugs has been quite long. I've had difficulty uploading images of receipts since April and it's still nit resolve. This aside, I completely love the app

records.title: The app works well and does what it…
records.text: The app works well and does what it says - the interest rate is also generous which is what attracted my business in the first place. However, the support is absolutely terrible copy pasting pre-made messages loosely relevant to your initial question (some training or additional staff is required). Also, their AML and KYC processes are pretty manual making the use of the bank very slow and having to justify a lot your transactions.

records.title: I find it really hard to communicate…
records.text: I find it really hard to communicate with tide, I send messages to them on the app but I don't get my problem resolved it's very frustrating.  I messaged a few days ago and still no response the AI  bots must be sleeping. It's not been great.

records.title: 'Support' is really not very supportive!
records.text: Opening the account was easy but the first question I need help with has so far been awaiting any reply from 'support' for over 72 hours... Still waiting...Now either this is an attempt to get me to pay for phone support, or the support team is incapable of helping me..At this moment I am considering closing the account as it is not up to standard

records.title: Easy to open an account but wouldn't recommend…
records.text: Easy to open an account and app is good. BUT if you ever experience and problems or have any questions, their support chat is absolutely diabolical. I cannot access two of my three accounts at present, due to a change they have made with their upgraded design and I have been waiting for over 8 hrs for a reply. My last issue which was early 2024, was questioning why I kept receiving random messages from their support chat. They admitted there was a problem their end and 'apparently' had a team of specialists working on it to rectify the problem (obviously lies). It took several months to get sorted. Pretty much the only problem I have with them is the reaction and response to customer problems, but this is a huge fail and would prevent me ever recommending them.

records.title: Tide Bank, Poor Quality Customer Service
records.text: My Business Acct has been open for over a year, when everything is going well Tide is fine but the App Based approach makes it difficult to resolve issues effectively as Tide Bank is by no means proactive in communicating.1) During the verification process of transferring a large amount of money £XXX,XXX to another bank, the App did not recognise the genuine Sort Code and corrected me, causing me to add the wrong Payee to my Account and encouraging me to override the checks, l nearly sent the money to wrong bank.2) The App still doesn't recognise the Account details entered, which l have verified myself independently as genuine from Google.3) The Transfer has still not been made nearly 2 weeks after the request Tide Bank has been sitting on my £XXX,XXX and l am unable to reverse the payment via the App. 4) I have been in contact Tide Bank 4 times as l was instructed via email, the issue has yet to be resolve, no telephone calls or emails.5) I felt obliged to take time warn other Customers of the likely issues with this App Based Bank.

records.title: The set up is real easy but online chat…
records.text: The set up is real easy but online chat support very poor. For most simple requests the average response time over 12 hours. Not good. Revolut business banking respond within 10 mins On the plus side you get a good rate of interest on your deposits but they only allow for one account operator so good for 1 man/woman business's but not for bigger entities

records.title: Watch those charges
records.text: Set up a new account with a free trial of Plus. Was charged for it within a week (an accident on their end they said). They refunded and cancelled, fine.Set up another account and the same thing happened! Charged for Plus by accident so contacted support and they refunded it BUT didn’t cancel it.I got a notification yesterday saying I’d be charged so I cancelled. Got charged today anyway and talking to customer service is not getting me anywhere.I was also charged for the accounting service which I’ve never used and which they make it really hard to find where to cancel.So they’ve had £40 from me in a week for services I don’t want.

records.title: Chatbot is waiting to connect you......
records.text: Just set up a Tide business account but because I chose not to pay monthly for a Premium account, they basically don't want to know. Chatbot has been waiting to connect me to an agent for over an hour, which is an absolute joke. It's pretty clear they're only interested in those who pay for the high end accounts but when you've just started a business, saving money is key. Feel like I've been conned and will probably close it and go with a more traditional high street bank like my other businesses.

records.title: Tide policies hurt my business
records.text: Tide isn't a real bank so key suppliers (Google & AWS) see it as a prepaid card so you can't use your bank account to pay for them. Also, they randomly will decide that transaction isn't going to be processed and leave it pending for long periods of time. These two things consistently impact my business.

records.title: Tide wont allow cheques to be paid in why not?
records.text: Tide do not allow a cheque to be paid inmy business, in building, finds it difficult enough to get paid anyway but when you cant pay our payment in, then it is hopelessTide say tell the customer to do a bank transferfat chance of thatTide sort it out for small business

records.title: 100% Good car finance services

records.title: It was really straight forward
records.text: It was really straight forward, happy they accepted me as I desperately needed a car, which entails me getting to and from work as I’m self employed. So far so good, can’t complain!

records.title: After ensuring that all i had to do was…
records.text: After ensuring that all i had to do was show up at the delearship and drive away. I was made to wait for long long time only to be told that I was now required to pay deposit which i did not have as i had spent it settling an account i did not need to settle as it was the final condition in order to secure finance. records.title: Hiccups but was resolved! Very happy!
records.text: I used ZUTO to find a car finance, start line had accepted me, but there was a lot of stuff they needed due to my situation- I needed to VT my old vehicle, they wanted this and that and caused a lot of stress and hiccups! However we managed to get it sorted, and luckily was able to collect the car that day, after thinking it was going to be over a week!Overall I’m so far impressed. Via email and post, so I can get on top of setting up my direct debit for a date that works for me!Overall I’m happy and impressed, couldn’t fault anything, hopefully continues throughout the finance !

records.title: Good service
records.text: It’s great to be approved for finance by yourselves. Communication was good. There were times we had to email back and forth requiring information or change or information, it was all communicated well.

records.title: Refinancing with Startline MF
records.text: This turned out to be way more convoluted than necessary although in no way because of the team who were nothing but very responsive and supportive.  Specific team members worthy of note were Mohammed Javed Miah​ and Aimee Stevenson who went over and above the call of duty.

records.title: All good only let down was the link on…

records.title: Super polite and very professional…
records.text: Super polite and very professional especially Sam Patel. Was a massive help and guided me to get my car sorted.

records.title: Almost a seamless experience

Easy to talk to, easy messaging service with texts as well as your online account. Will probably look here first next time when I eventually need another car

records.title: Thank you
records.text: Thank you for giving myself a much needed boost to get a new car. Only had the one conversation by phone with yourselves regarding t&c. As Car finance dealt with most of it. Only thing i said from getting off the phone with the lady, was she sounded like a robot just going through the motions

records.title: Your response is fantastic but your…
records.text: Your response is fantastic but your percentage is a lot for the car. The calculation I don’t understand. All I know is that I need a car. But I can’t speak to you directly to understand it. Keep up the good work. You can send me the calculations please. Thank You.

records.title: Excellent service

records.title: I never personally sorted finance as…

records.title: Satisfied customer
records.text: You are a great company to work with.
