records.title: The process was so quick and easy great…
records.text: The process was so quick and easy great customer service from the start. From the start of my application to deliver of my new car was all done within 48 hours

records.title: Honestly first time doing finance and…
records.text: Honestly first time doing finance and probably not going to do again. From the beginning dealing with zuto I should have known. I've had a few mixed messages and feel that I've been lied to about a few things. However I recently called and spoke with someone in the finance team and she explained it to me. You could do better by being honest and not make me feel your trying to sell me something and make as much money as you can from people. Hire people who will do what they say. Make things more clear

records.title: Apr is high
records.text: The 19% Apr is higher than I was expecting  but I have very few options to purchase the vehicle  so it's like one hand tied

records.title: Stressful…
records.text: Kept asking me for the same information which I had already sent. Then asked for more information. I flu d it very stressful. This all happened because I could not sign the form on my tablet. It should be easy to sign on any device. We got there eventually after several days

records.title: Mixed bag
records.text: My experience with Startline has been a mixed bag. I initially took out finance through Big Motoring World, but the car turned out to be faulty. After a lengthy back-and-forth with Big Motoring World, my car was eventually exchanged—an additional six-hour ordeal with Startline on top of the initial finance process. While I finally ended up with a working car, I later discovered I wasn’t being charged as agreed. After chasing this up 3–4 times, I was bizarrely told that I didn’t have finance with them.This odd business practice led me to stop pursuing it, leaving them to finally contact me when they needed to get the paperwork sorted. I had already wasted far too much time dealing with checks through BMW and Startline, which felt unnecessary.That said, recent conversations with their team have been relatively positive, but given the hassle I’ve endured, awarding 3 stars feels generous.

records.title: I got a call and mentioned the wiper…
records.text: I got a call and mentioned the wiper blade was broken. The agent that call was going to get back to the owner and back to me regarding the wiper blade. Still waiting on a call back to an email.

records.title: An OK experience…
records.text: Not much correspondence during the finance application process and was not notified when I was accepted - the dealership rang me directly arouns 3 days later to confirm so. Was not given a point of contact either so was kind of left in the dark. Overall, not a super positive or super negative experience.

records.title: Carfinance247 helped me find a new car
records.text: Carfinance247 helped me find a new car, and my friend Cheik recommended Startline Motor to help finance it. I don't know how it will all end, but so far, everything is going well. The communication has been great throughout the process, and I never had to follow up with them. I’m just praying it all works out.

records.title: Happy but stressful
records.text: After agreeing to the finance and giving all paperwork that was asked for we continued to get asked for more and more documents. This was a struggle as most things are in my wife’s name as she deals with everything as it’s easier for her to discuss things on the phone. Happy that finance was given but this held up the purchase of our car and cause a lot of stress

records.title: I was delighted to be offered car…
records.text: I was delighted to be offered car finance after many failed attempts but the online system is confusing. I must have been sent requests to sign 5 agreements over the course of 2 weeks with different monthly payments to the original amounts agreed. In fairness I should have checked them more thoroughly so I'll take the hit. The first one I signed was for 160 per month but when I have received my letter it states 200 + pounds. 40 extra a month is a big difference over the time period. Whilst it is convenient to complete these things on your phone I would have perhaps spotted the anomalies if I had a computer or laptop!

records.title: Higher charges for  those who can't afford it.
records.text: I was very grateful for the offer of a loan after many dissapointments elsewhere but it is at a punative interest rate.I had little choice but to accept but it seems those who aren't gilt-edged clients get penalised the most!

records.title: First impressions aren't great
records.text: First impressions aren't great. Approved for finance via arnold clark, asked to change deposit to be told they wouldn't lend me the amount. Wen't to a broker who got me the new amount and guess what, its from startline. Haven't got the car yet but they've sent me the direct debit details so apparently I'm already paying for it.

records.title: The jury is still out.
records.text: The jury is still out.. Great start to the agreement, but had to advise of a payment change date due to salary change. Two months notice given, however no details found on file. Good job I called to check. I hope that Startline review their files so we don't have to have uncomfortable conversations on the future..??

records.title: Had a bad experience due to broking company Zuto
records.text: To begin with I was told by Zuto representative that I can pay a deposit of £1000 and get balance amount financed. However, later the rep came back to me and said Starline refused the finance. After 2 days he calls me again and said if you pay a deposit if £2500 they are willing to process your application. So, I don't know who played the game here. So, here is the rating but for Zuto the rating will be -3 stars.

records.title: Finance for immigrants
records.text: I am grateful for the finance you provided me with. However, I considered the interest rate too high. Although I am an immigrant, it does not necessarily mean I represent a high-risk contract. The company should create a tool to classify or analyse the immigrant's status. Some immigrant statuses can represent more risk than others. In my case, for example, the risk for the finance company would be minimum because of the kind of status and job that I have in the UK. I know that, but the company does not know because it does not have a specific tool to evaluate it.

records.title: I was able to take out car finance.
records.text: I didn't take the car that my account manager help choose for me, as it wasn't appropriate for my mother to get in and out of.  But it was said I was able to change the car which would take a while anyway so I left it.  Without any issues as yet.  Both sides where ok about it and I will sort something out again later.  Startline finance through Car finance 247 has help me out before and hopefully again in the future.

records.title: long wait
records.text: the finance was agreed and I went to collect my car, I waited for 3 hours whilst the salesman tried to sort the issues out. this included being informed after 2hrs that my bank statements were needed, which you had already had access to my bank details, then a picture  of my debit card, then more bank statements.I know you need to be careful with money laundering but this was ridiculous, the finance manager from Perrys Preston got involved, I had to leave with my old car after 3 hours of waiting. the issue was resolved on Friday however I was unable to collect the car so had to wait till Saturday.I had to do a temporary insurance on my old car so i could drive it.I am grateful that you were prepared to offer me finance but I was left disappointed and frustrated with the procedure.

records.title: The time it took to get a final…
records.text: The time it took to get a final decision was extremely long, considering I already had been approved and previously took out a vehicle with which was paid off in full. The process could have been a lot more straightforward and smooth

records.title: Thank you for the offer of finance
records.text: Thank you for the offer of finance. I was well happy. HOWEVER on Fri afternoon a schoolboy on his was home from school was looking where he was going and thinking he owned the road decided to cross the road without looking and hit the side of the car and denting the wing and buckling his front wheelSat morn we drove to Manchester to collect the new car. On the part exchange they inspected my car came back in and said they have to refuse the car because of the dent. Was not a happy Teddy beat and cancelled the deal

records.title: Resolved in the end, but needed to escalate to the ombudsman
records.text: Car developed a fault, and Startline/dealer refused to cover the full costs of returning the car to the originating dealer - despite it being a four-hour round-trip each way - and no offer of a reduced rental or courtesy car whilst the fault was to be fixed.I escalated to the Financial Ombudsman, and whilst doing so agreed (relucantly) to take the time off work to return the car/take the hit of paying rentals for something I couldn't use.I contacted the dealer to sort this, but heard nothing back. Every time I chase Startline (at least once a week, over seven weeks), they kept saying the delay was with Zuto.Startline eventually agreed to the Ombudsmans ruling, and paid the full cost to repair locally, as well as other costs incurred as part of the fault.This took several months to get what I feel was an option that should have just been offered at the outset (hence the stars dropped).Thanks goes to Theo for taking ownership to resolve: the other agent's took weeks to respond, and moved this no further forward to resolving.

records.title: This is my first correspondence from…
records.text: This is my first correspondence from you since having my policy. I'm still waiting on my documents to come through or even a welcome email. Very poor communication.

records.title: The E sign procedure is majorly flawed…
records.text: The E sign procedure is majorly flawed and there is no option to do a wet sign this needs to be rectified either software improved or wet sign option made available

records.title: Changed poor customer service car within a car as it wasn't…
records.text: Changed car within a car as it wasn't functional for me.kept the same finance company but got charged an extra £290. For the change over. Not a happy  customer

records.title: Terrifically inefficient
records.text: Terrifically inefficient, no accountability for their own actions and, quite frankly, not worth dealing with. Were I not in dire need of the vehicle I got, I would have walked.No, Startline, I don't want to discuss my 'experience' with you - it serves no purpose, so please don't be ringing me and wasting my time.Edit: As is demonstrated in their comment below, they don't listen to their customer at all and have no regard for them as individuals.

records.title: Really good when it comes to customer…
records.text: Really good when it comes to customer service however I have had NUMEROUS issues with my car and I’ve had it only just touching 12 months and had it repaired 8 times!! Given the warranty I have I have had no help and am fobbed off every single time :) useless

records.title: Offered very little help when I had…
records.text: Offered very little help when I had issues with the dealership, passed the buck to them with no empathy or understanding (first time I've ever had a deal fall through). Over several interactions, I haven't felt valued as a customer, nor have I felt them to be approachable. If all you want is finance with no customer service, they'll probably fill your need but consider that if you run into financial difficulties, they *may* not be the most helpful.

records.title: Poor Comunication
records.text: Startline were not great at communicating the amount of time it would take for them pay out the finance. I had to chase frequently which caused anxiety as I was on a time crunch, when they did communicate, they would provide arbitrary deadlines, later stating that they have no idea why we were given those deadlines as they don't provide deadlines as a rule of thumb.

records.title: I was hoping to pay a bigger deposit
records.text: I was hoping to pay a bigger deposit Before I even viewed the car the finance was cleared and the dealership got paid.On my arrival the dealership had no interest in my concerns as he had already been paid for the car.You should not have released the funds for the car until I was happy with car and then you could have requested a picture of myself holding my driver license once I was happy to proceed.Very disappointing experience.Always in contact during my application but once cleared for finance it all went downhill from there.I got the car but now the £3000 deposit I had will only pay the interest.No wonder people get into debt.You put me in debt before I viewed the car.

records.title: Should not say accepted until all checks carried out
records.text: I was told all went through signed agreement and could pick car up on Tuesday 3rd Jan then was told needed more docs wage slips and then bank statements then I was told can’t doFinance as my wage slip was incorrect as I had received two weeks pay on the 22Dec and I said it was because holiday pay as close at Christmas my work . Finally you agreed to accept it but should have been a lot Simple it has really put me off using startline again and certainly wouldn’t recommend I finally picked up the vehicle 2 days later

records.title: The proposal information required was…
records.text: The proposal information required was completely unnecessary. After providing 5 wage slips and my p60 I didn't understand why you needed me to provide my contract of employment aswell. I've had various car finance agreements over the years and this is the first time I'm asked for this. This also slowed down the application so what and delayed me getting my new car by 4 days. Something so simple was made really hard work for a irrelevant piece of paper.

records.title: Everything OK until things go wrong and…
records.text: Everything OK until things go wrong and then they don't want to know.Unable to manage expectations and I was told that "the company has a policy of not returning phone calls" by one agent. Lengthy and very stressful complaints procedure and they give you the wrong advice. My complaint should have been resolved within 8 weeks but it took 4 months in the end.

records.title: Easy process all round
records.text: Ease  of setting up account and maturity process very simple.  Clearly explained all options and was able to split my previous investment between part re-investment and part redemption without any difficulty

records.title: Great rate
records.text: Great rate, simple process and very friendly and efficient customer service. Thanks guys!

records.title: Personal and efficient service
records.text: Always found Aldermore service first class. I have just renewed my fixed term ISA and the interest was paid easily into my nominated account.  Good interest rate. Any queries are dealt with personally and clearly by apatient member of staff.

records.title: Recommended
records.text: Much simpler to use now than before. Excellent rates of interest and easy to transfer money to our nominated account, whenever needed.

records.title: I have always found Aldermore…
records.text: I have always found Aldermore sensitive, responsive and effective in my dealings with them. They offer very competitive interest rates and an excellent on line banking service.

records.title: Great internet banking and competitive savings rates
records.text: Ease of use, great customer service if you find anything confusing, good interest rates for repeat customers.

records.title: Double Access account and Fixed Rate bond
records.text: When searching a couple of years ago, I found both their Double Access account and Fixed Rate bond very nicely suited what I was looking for.   Both were straightforward to open on line and have been easy to operate on line.  I’ve been happy with the interest rates. When my fixed rate bond was nearing maturity, I received an email, from where it was a simple matter to select what I wanted to happen with the funds.

records.title: Excellent fast service
records.text: Excellent fast service. Options explained clearly. Good rates and all sorted quickly.

records.title: Aldermore are very easy to deal with
records.text: Aldermore are very easy to deal with.  Staff are helpful and interest rates are competitive.  If I withdraw funds into my nominated account, I have to request it before 2pm if I need it that day.  After 2pm it arrives the following day.  I would like the funds to arrive on the same day but I just need to be organised to ask for it by the allotted time!

records.title: Clear and easy…

records.title: Maturity instructions clear

records.title: exxcellent bank

records.title: Easy to deal with
records.text: Easy to deal with, this lot provide info both digitally and hard copy

records.title: Used this company for investments quite…

records.title: Easy to renew and paperwork is…
records.text: Easy to renew and paperwork is excellent to follow our investment.Love that we are able to have a joint account, which is important as we get into Older age.They give better rates to acknowledge loyalty which is good too.Shame their top rate is a bit lower than the market this time, hence 4* only this time

records.title: I've been investing fixed interest for…
records.text: I've been investing fixed interest for years with Aldermore and never have had any problems. Website secure and easy to navigate.

records.title: Simple system/reasonable rates of interest
records.text: Simple system/process to roll over to new account. Reasonable rates of interest if not market leading.

records.title: Good
records.text: Competitive savings bank for fixed ISAs at the moment. Easy straight forward online navigation and account management. Online queries answered promptly. Its a bit buggy with my Brave browser (which they admit to and asked me to try a different browser.) Works fine with Chrome. It would be nice if they had an App with biometric login as well as online access.

records.title: if it goes pear shaped perservere.
records.text: An administrative nightmare... If you've a couple of days to waste trying to open an account it may be worth it but from the limited experience I have they leave the impression that putting money into the care of their systems would be putting it into a big black hole.I was contacted by Aldermore Bank and fair play they went out of their way to put things right and to be fair the Post Office address database has a hand in this. The moral of the story if it goes pear shaped perservere.

records.title: I misunderstood the re-investment…
records.text: I misunderstood the re-investment instructions and ended up having the interest earned on maturity paid into my bank account. Not wholly my fault, I feel. Otherwise I have found the helpline staff excellent and the investment interest rates competitive over the past two years.

records.title: Satisfied Customer
records.text: I have 2 savings accounts with Aldermore and have had them for 2 or 3 years. I find the site easy to use and making withdrawals and deposits is easy.I find their communication on mature dates and interest rate changes is clear and well timed.Occasionally the interest rate they pay lags the market but they usually catch up.

records.title: Generally helpful and easy to deal with
records.text: While it's not necessarily saying a lot in this day and age, some of the best customer service I can get from a financial institution or any large call centre.  There are some limitations on products but they're all set out.  Customer services (telephone) generally answered reasonably quickly and all the advisers I've spoken to have been easy to understand and helpful.It's not always immediately obvious how to make payments in - it could be set out better on the website - but support staff are very helpful and once set up no problems.

records.title: All settled thank you.
records.text: Its been a bit of a struggle but I have finally had my deposit of £10k returned plus a bit of compensation. Had a nice letter explaining why there had been a months delay which I now fully understand. You are too busy having exceeded your expectations of new business! Complaint withdrawn in this review!!

records.title: Deposit difficulty
records.text: My wife has been trying to pay money into her ISA. It has been a real pain. She has had to make multiple calls over several days following making a deposit and still the funds have not been deposited in the assigned account. Following above the issue was resolved. Apparently someone had made an error in effecting the transfer into the account. Looks like a one-off issue but it did take too long to resolve. I have amended the rating accordingly.

records.title: Go to Financial Company for great rates
records.text: Very competitive interest rates makes it an immediate go to when looking to invest cash. Dealing with Aldermore on line is easy and maturity options are clearly advised. Have mentioned this before. Please make an App available.

records.title: Everything Online and easy to use
records.text: Very easy to use as you nominate a bank and all money transfers come and go via that bank. I've never had an issue either with money being deposited or with funds being retrieved. Always happen within next bank working day after instructions given. I've never needed to contact Customer Support so cannot really comment on their capabilities. However, if you are after a flexible savings account with known interest rates then they are certainly worth consideration.

records.title: Pretty Decent So Far
records.text: Been with Aldermore for 3 years and opened/transferred as many ISA's with/to them in that time. Never had any issues, paperwork always turned up as promised, online account access is always fine, website is fine, and never had to wait long on few occassions I needed to telephone customer support (which clearly sounds based in UK).They dont often offer the absolute top interest rates but always seem up there with the best on many occassions.Only negative is I've been unable so far to persuade them to consider a reward for introducing a new customer to invest with them.

records.title: Top Marks to Aldermore Bank
records.text: I already had a savings account with Aldermore and wanted to open an ISA as they always offer some of the Top Interest Rates on the market. When opening the ISA with Aldermore I had a minor difficulty with selection on their Website as different types of accounts are grouped with large Icons which are all the same colour. However I called Customer Services and they understood my problem. They were professional, knowledgeable and friendly; they walked me through the process and resolved my problem within 24hrs. Thanks Connor and Carl.Thanks Aldermore Bank.

records.title: Fair rate of interest on Fixed Term Deposit
records.text: Fair rate of interest on Fixed Term Deposits. Helpful advisor when I telephoned for assistance with maturity options. Telephone answered promptly, spoke to an advisor without having being kept on hold and having to listen to annoying music for ages.

records.title: Good customer service, but poor rates at present
records.text: If rates were competitive I would have kept investment with them as their customer service is good. Unfortunately, there are more favourable rates available elsewhere, and whilst customer service is important to me, the rate difference is too much to remain with them.I would however consider investing again with them if their rates were good.Don't seem able to log in now that my account is closed ?

records.title: customer service
records.text: customer service, what customer service have they got one as i have been on the phone 30 mins and no one answers.eventually i got though and he apologized (not his fault afterall}he sorted out what i was after, very good customer service its just getting through to talk to someone

records.title: Not bad but nothing to shout about
records.text: I got drawn in with a reasonable interest rate for my business savings. This has just been reduced. There is no app so you have to sit at your PC or ipad with your phone in hand. There are no live feeds to your accounting software.

records.title: Waiting times
records.text: Like other customers I think waiting for a call-handler takes too long. You should therefore employ more staff. Also I had to ring because your online system was telling me my Customer ID (which I was copying from a letter received that day) &/or my email were wrong. Hence the long wait to speak too someone. When I did finally speak to someone they were pleasant, knowledgeable & helpful

records.title: Investment Okay
records.text: Okay, I am happy with the investment side, BUT I’m not happy with the difficulty experienced when both online AND trying to get through to speak to a customer service team member.  When trying to re-invest or open a new account, it is not always clear online what information is required.  Maybe prompt guidance would help??Also, why should customers have to wait a very long time (costing them a lot of money) to try and speak to a member of staff.  Having to wait over 45 minutes is not helpful when stressed already.

records.title: Limited website
records.text: The bank is fine but their website is terrible since a so called update  Feb 24. I ( and many others ) now have to use an old out of date browser to access their site as my up to date browse (which always use to work) no longer does.What I have seen of the (new) website is not as good as the previous one, forcing statements as monthly pdf's and not allowing date ranges or annual statements to be produced. This my be a limit of having to use an old browser but can't tell.

records.title: They are ok but not the best
records.text: They are ok.Their technology however seems stuck in the early 2000's and their mortgage portal is in serious need of improvement.I have been told for the last 3 years that the portal "is being updated" which is complete BS.Other than the rubbish mortgage portal and somewhat poor communication at times, they are a decent bunch

records.title: Problems with communication but OK in the end.
records.text: We had a few problems in closing our account. There was no explanation or communication as to why. I sent two emails asking what the problem/s were but had no response. After writing a bad review here we did get a call from the complaints department who were able to provide an explaination and resolution that resolved the issue.

records.title: No onine access from overseas
records.text: Difficult to speak to customer service.Whilst on an overseas visit to the USA, it was impossible to log-on, and I was unable to make an important transaction. I tried calling customer service but no-one answered despite a long (and expensive) wait. Not acceptable in this day and age.

records.title: Inefficient ISA transfer
records.text: Took 3 working days following maturity to transfer an ISA that had over 3 weeks acknowledgement of instruction. The ISA matured on a Saturday so assumed transfer would be the Monday, ie next working day. Took until the Wednesday. Whist I rang on the Monday to enquire as to the transfer the agent advised it was in the system! Whilst it ear't interest it was not the same as new provider.

records.title: My father has just died
records.text: My father has just died and has an account with you - I'm saddened that you're one of the old fashioned companies that requires a copy of grant of probate, knowing that this is going to take many months to obtain, when the money is his, or his estate's.  Most other companies just ask for a death certificate and proof of executors.  This is just prolonging the difficult time we are already suffering and it is unnecessary.  Shame, as I'd always thought highly of Aldermore, would consider whether to use them again or not in the future.

records.title: Problems with access
records.text: I have a business savings account with £20k in savings and VERY OFTEN can't access my account. It keeps telling me the login code they are sending me is wrong. It erases my details when I submit and just returns me to login page. When by some miracle after 10 tries I manage to log in, I can view the dashboard, as soon as I click into the account it just says "loading accounts please wait" and stays there. It's incredibly frustrating, the website is very basic and problematic. Having said that, whenever I've spoken to the customer service team they are lovely and helpful.

records.title: Login to the website doesn't work from different areas of the website. …
records.text: Login to the website is made that much more difficult by being given the wrong login address to begin with. Once logged in, the website is pretty woeful. It needs to be made more user friendly and less info to read when wishing to instruct or make an enqiry. Too much of my time is wasted in doing what I have previously instructed and in giving feedback.

records.title: Could be better

records.title: A few improvements needed but generally good
records.text: I like it’s easy to get hold of a person and opening an account was super easy . Interest rates are good .However after making deposits they froze the account to do some more checks and should have done these before letting me deposit . They sorted the issue after a week but it shouldn’t of happened.

records.title: Service is good but slow to apply rate increases
records.text: Service is good.  Their saving rates are not as competitive as they used to be.  The speed increasing their rate after any rise by the Bank of England is now becoming very slow to apply.

records.title: Customer service delays in responding…
records.text: Customer service delays in responding to enquiries are excessive now.  Recent contact took 2 months to get an initial answer when the  website indicated that they aimed to respond in 5 working days.  The website site is fine and easy to navigate and use  and the account management is fine but the customer service is becoming lamentable.  More action needed to address the issues.

records.title: everything works ok

records.title: Excellent service from beginning to…

records.title: Wait Times Far Too Long

records.title: Not as good as they used to be

I was able to transfer some of this without penalty but now have to lose 30 days interest to transfer the rest. Also slow to make the transfer. Kent Reliance transferred a cash isa within 24 hours, Aldermore is procrastinating over theirs. They seem to think it’s their money not mine.

records.title: Extremely difficult to inform them of…

Very parochial

Passwords are not being mailed, so access to accounts is impossible.

records.title: Communication & service leaves a lot to be desired.
records.text: I have been very happy with Aldermore in the past and provided them with 5* rating on Trustpilot and other review sites, but lately their service level has dropped significantly. Don't get responses to emails and have tried contacting customer services numerous times by phone only to have to hang up after 30+ minutes wait each time. I am moving my funds away from them now. They have forgotten an important lesson..."Service is the differentiator".

records.title: Edit - Difficult to contact by telephone
records.text: Edit - had a call yesterday from a very helpful guy called Thomas, he explained reason for long wait & was apologetic, helpful & efficient answering my questions. Happy to give them the benefit of the doubt & hope it’s easier to contact next time. Easy to open an account on line but wait until you try contacting their customer service team by phone 🤦‍♀️ Been waiting 30 minutes listening to a recording telling me my call is important to them and they are sorry but they are very busy at the moment, well clearly my call isn’t important to them and they need more staff.

records.title: Poor conduct and attitude to customers
records.text: Good rates, ok website, beware of poor conduct and attitude to customers. e.g.1. Had a savings account for 4+ years. Then received a phishing like email (worded like it came from scammers) asking for confidential data and threatening to freeze account. 5 days later account frozen, and refused to re-open it, even after clearing security.  Reason: Aldermore changed some account requirement that urgently needed some extra data, then mismanaged the comms and so only way to access money was to close the account.e.g.2. Account opening issues. Much pain and effort because my wife's surname has a hyphen and one ID from an utility company showed it without. An already laborious process took 6 weeks to resolve. Got £75 compensation both times, but they took no action to improve their processes/attitude.

records.title: Unfair Review Featured
records.text: This is not so much a review as a comment on another review - the one headed 'All Good - No Problems' by Nigel Ely. My understanding was that when writing reviews it was not good protocol to mention other companies and this one mentions Lloyds Bank in a negative way which is a bit unfair as Lloyds do not get a chance to respond and the complaint is somewhat vague e.g. they are interested in making a profit. I was looking at banks and despite the 5 stars awarded, this has rather put me off the bank under review.

records.title: Quidco is my go to
records.text: Am an advocate for Quidco. Easy to track progress. Good options on taking cash back. And lots of sites available to earn just a bit extra.

records.title: Seamless
records.text: Simple, effective process. Why not, it costs nothing?

records.title: The cashback rates are pretty good.
records.text: The cashback rates are pretty good but some of the times you have to wait are too long. You also have make sure you clear the cache as sometimes it doesn't go through.

records.title: Great
records.text: Great - just a shame it takes many many months for cashback to come through from retailer.  Otherwise, all good thanks.

records.title: Easy to use cashback
records.text: Easy to use cashback always paid some times quiet a while after the initial purchase has been made. But Happy to carry-on using Quidco.

records.title: Money back for free
records.text: Cashback on things I was already going to buy. Sometimes it doesn't work unfortunately. Wouldn't shop online without it.

records.title: Great way to save some money on purchases
records.text: I have saved lots of money with Quidco just by using my account when buying anything I need. Had an account with them for over 10 years and customer support has been great when needed. The only issue I have encountered is with some retailers deciding to decline cashback and there is no challenging them! Any retailer can decide to not pay cashback even it is a valid transaction.

records.title: Getting paid to shop. You can make a nice amount back if you shop regularly.
records.text: So far so good. Have cashed out once so far and the app is easy to use but you do sometimes have check that the correct Cashback percentage has been used, but making a claim is easy thankfully.Only thing I didn't like is when I signed up, I was not told that I was going onto the Premium account which takes £1 every month out of your Cashback earned amount. It was 5 months before I worked it out so lost £5. So far I have noticed no real difference between the Basic and Premium accounts. Slightly lower Cashback percentages maybe but that's about it.It's fun to watch your Cashback increase.

records.title: Any free money is a bonus!
records.text: Quidco is a great methodology of getting free cash provided you abide by the rules for purchasing on the site. Even then sometimes the Cashback doesn’t always track or get accepted. Because of this I would always advise on making sure you are happy with the baseline purchase price before you buy, then if you get the Cashback it’s a Brucey bonus. But if fails you still haven’t lost out.

records.title: Quidco is a good cashback website
records.text: Quidco is a good cashback website, one of the early ones. Personally I prefer Topcashback generally as the rates are higher but Quidco do sometimes have offers which match them

records.title: Not all cash back meets the retailers qualifying requirements and claims are sometimes not tracked or declined. Also, sometimes  it takes a very long time for the cash back  to be paid.
records.text: Quidco is a great way to earn cash back on qualifying purchases with a wide variety of retailers.  They also provide good customer service if you have any problems.Definitely worth using.

records.title: Worth a try
records.text: It works well, you can get paid little amounts per transaction and over the years it builds up to be quite a big amount. I will mention the app sometimes struggles to track orders and sometimes declines your funds for no reason.

records.title: Quidco is a very good cashback sight…
records.text: Quidco is a very good cashback sight and before purchasing anything on line I always check the Quidco website to see if cashback is available. The only problem I have found is that sometimes your purchase does not register and you have to raise a claim and I have had a few claims rejected. I would give Quidco 9 out of 10 as a cashback sight.

records.title: Could be improved
records.text: It’s easy to use and there is such a variety of cashback offers. I have only given 4 stars as this year in particular I have noticed it’s taking a lot longer than normal to actually get the cachback in your account and I have had to appeal a few that were declined. I’m now 1 year down the line with one cashback transaction in particular. 6 months for Quidco to review it after it was declined and now 5months of it sitting with the retailer for them to review it, the item was purchased on 15th November 2023!

records.title: Good but be careful
records.text: Good but read the terms and conditions carefully otherwise you will not get cashback.For example if you use Quidco Compare and save the quote you will not get the cashback if you return to the saved quote you have to buy immediately when the first quote is generated or get a fresh quote and buy immediately.Why do they offer to save quote if it disqualifies cashback.You also have many other hurdles in the small print.Read carefully and it will work but they could improve it . Have saved £1800 over ten years

records.title: I've used Quidco for several years now
records.text: I've used Quidco for several years now, done if the flashbacks are really excellent. However, I am never sure I will get the cashback promised. A few years ago I bought a bathroom suite going through quidco, I thought I had done everything right and was really looking forward to the over hundred pound cashback but then a few weeks later it was declined. Even though I appealed it was still denied. I would like to see Quidco insisting partner companies honour the deals. I was just told there was nothing they could do. I've noticed some of the companies have very confusing offers for cashback and some really complex instructions. One recently was a comparison site it appeared you had to go through quidco app and had to buy the policy straight away - that's difficult on a big purchase and means other sites can't be checked. I've earned some cashback and that's great Just wish it was simpler

It didn't track.I went in to raise a manual process, when I select yesterday's purchase, I got back the message saying "Quidco Compare Car Insurance does not allow raising claims" like WTH.thanks, never again will I use your tool for anything. records.title: Really doing good
records.text: Really doing good. Sometimes we do get good discount and product purchases. Something is better than nothing so go ahead with it

records.title: Good to be notified of retailer visits and cashback received.
records.text: It's a good feeling to have a wide choice in retailers online. The cashback notifications are useful. In most cases I am notified that Quidco has registered the sites that they've forwarded me onto. Some of the time I've noticed Quidco hasn't registered, when I come out of the retailed site after payment. Hopefully this will be improved in time. Hence why I gave 4 star.

records.title: On the whole it is a good site but I…
records.text: On the whole it is a good site but I have found lately that my purchases are not being tracked...all of my September purchases are missing and nothing has tracked since November.  I  contacted them and thought the issue was resolved but it has not been

records.title: Mixed feelings
records.text: I've been using Quidco for years and have very mixed feelings about it. I've had some purchases track and pay fine, but many of my purchases haven't been tracked. Whenever I raise a case about these, the case always seem to get declined by the retailer. This has happened to me several times for larger purchases, which is very frustrating as I would have considered a different cashback service, or a different retailer if I knew it wasn't going to track. I follow the advice from Quidco on how to make sure your purchases track, but this doesn't work half of the time. I have had tracked cashback over the years, which is nice to have some, but the amount of items that haven't tracked and have also been larger purchases is increasingly frustrating. I choose the retailer I'm buying with based on the cashback sometimes, but I don't think that I can always do that now as the system is unreliable.

records.title: Cashback are sometimes slow to arrive
records.text: Cashback are sometimes slow to arrive due to retailers being so random with their payout times.Also it can be difficult to track cashback bonuses as you don’t cross reference which purchases are linked to which bonuses.

records.title: Long wait for cash back to confirm
records.text: Seems to have gone downhill recently. In the past holiday cash back would be paid within the stated 8-12 weeks. Well no more. It’s been nearly six months since my Expedia trip completed and the estimated payment date has been and gone. No one can give an accurate picture of when I will be paid and I seem to be getting copy and paste answers. It’s frustrating and disappointing. Thought long and hard before posting this review because previous experience has been excellent but something has changed. Makes me question whether I will continue using the service. Also beginning to wonder if I will ever see this money :-(  UPDATE: Cashback finally confirmed after leaving this review so I have updated my experience to a three star.

records.title: It's ok
records.text: I always try to go through Quidco for purchases. When it works, it's great  However, it doesn't work very well for me most of the time.  Claims take a long, long time to be paid out and missing transactions .  The percentage of cashback is also really poor.Edited after reply to say I remember raising more than one claim.  Obviously it was over 2 years ago then. Thanks for the reply.

records.title: OK when it works
records.text: When it works it's great but 90% of things do not track and claims once declined they will not bother trying to get the cashack, you get the "cashback isn't promised" that won't wash if someone too Quidco to court as theyt are offering a incentive to use their site to purchase things and a incentive must be honored as per law.You get the usual scripted reply about cookies, adblockers etc, i know my IT i know how cookies work i use a fresh browser where only Quidco is used so that script doesn't wash with meUse TCB they are much better and if a claim is declined they will try to get you the cashback that is rightfully yours, i will no longer be using Quidco.

records.title: I used to love Quidco
records.text: I used to love Quidco, but recently I have had problems with the cashback tracking. I have had to submit a manual claim for the last three transactions. Two of these should have also had a £10 bonus amount as well as the usual %. Unfortunately, there is no way for me to raise the additional bonus amount. The manual process takes a ridiculously long time. I find other cashback sites, such as Topcashback, to be far more responsive. It is a shame because I used to love this site but its not worth the hassle.

records.title: Second best cashback site
records.text: Quidco was the first cashback site I ever used but now my preference is to use Topcashback as I find their tracking to be more reliable.  Quidco frequently offers a £5 bonus for Ebay purchases and I used such an offer on the 19th November. Sadly, and not for the first time, the purchase didn't track and so the £5 bonus will be lost.  Of course I have raised a claim for the missing cashback, but past experience tells me that Ebay will (after a six month wait) reject the claim. Will I never learn!

Only problem is that i've found that this site takes the longest to credit - sometimes upto 8 months! Also their 'bonuses'/games casback etc are quite difficult to earn.

records.title: The concept itself is good but the…

records.title: Payment

records.title: over promises, under delivers
records.text: as per previous reviews, Quidco are 'hit or miss' as to whether you get cashback or not. When approached with a request to look into a missing payment the standard reply announcing the retailers rejection is common. So for e.g. Ebay it is a 'must use', e.g. Screwfix is 'don't waste your time'. A triumph of hype over reality. However, as frequent users of Ebay, the rewards have added up.

records.title: Going down hill.
records.text: I have been a Quidco customer since 2006. The range of cashback used to be incredible and very few conditions meant that if you used the system correctly, you would get the cashback or bonus. I have fallen foul of the conditions numerous times and accepted it. Now, the conditions are so complex to follow and very finite that you must do things in a particular way. I recently used Quidco to book three different hotel stays with the same hotel change. All from the one Quidco link - I have done it that way before so couldn't see why this wouldn't have worked. Sadly not this time. I was told all my fault as I couldn't prove the link in the transaction. Strange as the first transaction logged, the 2nd and 3rd were visible at the same time and I was able to log the claim against the two immediately following the first, yet for some reason 'the transaction could not be proven'. Again, clearly my fault, I should have deleted the cookies before I made the transaction (even though the transaction showed on the account - and never had to do this before). Glad to know, that something I have done successfully many times is, on this occasion, my fault - especially as the offer for the hotel chain was on a 'bonus' transaction offer and the lowest cashback value which wasn't on offer out of the three was successful, but the two with higher than usual offers were not successful.

records.title: We have to wait over 4 months for our Cashback
records.text: The fact I've had to wait over 4 months before I can have my cashback. This is absolutely ridiculous so why do we have to wait so long. It's our money & it's withheld from us for over 4 months! Cashback. You're wrong! I do have cashback waiting as it's been confirmed via email & it's on my account so stop telling fibs!

records.title: Used Quidco Car insurance and never…

records.title: good offers, but never pay you it seems
records.text: Quidco does offer some good cashback incentives however after having the app for almost 6 months, with multiple purchases throughout that time i haven't received a single penny. Everything is still sat in tracked cashback with no movement. One of the biggest ones was a car i purchased in september through cinch. I've had the car for months yet still to receive cashback.When you contact quidco they say they are waiting on the retailers, however for this to work you clearly need a stronger foothold or relationship with these retailers. I don't see the point in putting expected pay dates when they go months over with still no cashback payments. I've used other services which pay much quicker than this. As soon i get the cashback i'm owed from quidco i will moving to another platform unfortunately. 6 months+ for cashback is just mental. Has the potential to be great, but a lack of communication with retailers is slowing down cashback and ultimately frustrating customers and pushing them elsewhere. Poor really.

records.title: I got out of my way to buy products…
records.text: I got out of my way to buy products when i get a bonus offer in my email. Buy something straight away and buy it through the quidco tracking link. But the bonuses never get honoured. I do not have any trust with quidco anymore.

records.title: Your tracking experience is far worse than competitors
records.text: Unfortunately your tracking experience is far worse than competitor. I know my IT stuff with cookies and adblocker and all, even with cleared cookies and adblockers, I’m still getting high volume of missed tracking and claim denial  is far worse than the other competitors I use. Your front page cashback deals fools a lot of people thinking they will get it, but ended up getting denied.

records.title: Shocking service
records.text: My experience with Quidco has never been positive. Tracking of cashback is so difficult for some reason when it should be so straightforward; despite clearing cookies and doing everything according to instruction.  The ones that do are normally ones worth pennies. Following on from that you raise a claim and communication is never goo and there’s always a long delay.  When cashback does track you wait so long for it to be confirmed; Quidco say it’s the retailers, but I know another cashback firm processes their claims so much faster. I’ve waited a year for a referral fee from Quidco and when you try and speak to an advisor to ask why hasn’t it been processed nine months later, you get standard narrative about retailers processing time totally ignoring the fact it is them who should be processed it.  Furthermore, there are restrictions on the limited funds you can withdraw so if you have cashback under £1 you cannot withdraw so you end up leaving the money in the account for Quidco to make more money on. I won’t be using Quidco again.

What you guys need to improve is the limit per transaction and the monthly limit per transaction is very small.That’s what i think you need to do something about that.Regards

records.title: *I do not like the frequency of sending…
records.text: *I do not like the frequency of sending of my personal financial details/ bank statements & payslips- I find this really too intrusive.                                                 *I have had 2 accounts of the money I transferred was reportedly collected by somebody when the real recipient attended to collect the money. Only one of the 2 cases have since been resolved. The other, remains outstanding.                   *I don’t like when money is put on hold and there is a back and forth to get the money cleared and paid.                             *Other, fantastic service and 2nd to none: good competitive exchange rates, very convenient, easy online transfer, plenty of outlets in Sierra Leone- now even in villages 👍🏾 making it really easy for our loved ones to collect

records.title: This company is not good enough for its purpose
records.text: What I do not like the company is putting a limit on how much customers should send. For a person like me, I have a big family to support back home.So putting a limit on how much to send is not helpful at all. Comparing with other companies, ria monthly limit to send is £4000 and for Remitly you can send money as much you can with out being questioned. Another bad experience I have with you people is asking me for a proof of income any time I want to send any amount from £1000 and above.Thats why this time if you tell me I have reached my limit I just go to either ria or Remitly and  do my  business. What more details does Afro International want from me. Even today I wanted to send money to two of family members. They rejected the second transaction, telling me I  have exceeded  my monthly limit. And that I should call customer services if I wanted to send more. What an absurdity is that?

records.title: I was out of the country recently and…
records.text: I was out of the country recently and happened to conduct my monthly transactions, to my surprise a hold was put on all payments until I disclosed my location. The supervisor I spoke with was unprofessional and could not explain himself and their policies. Not a good mix.

records.title: It takes me over 12 hours to transfer…
records.text: It takes me over 12 hours to transfer the money they keep sending me references and the money not being able to collect it couple of time which is so frustrating. and also the Apple Pay is not working. I find it hard work because you don’t work with your bank card all the time.

records.title: This is the first time I'm using this…
records.text: This is the first time I'm using this service. I can't complain about the fee it's good compared to others however, there's an issue at the branch when my recipient went for the pick up. I received an email stating that my address on the card didn't match the one I filled which doesn't make sense. I was asked to upload a proof of ID which I did. Why wait till someone goes to pick up before they ask the sender to verify their identity/address or whatever? To top it all, the individual I spoke to was kinda rude when he asked me to update my card details for future transactions, upon which I asked him what he meant as I was confused because I've been using this card all this while and it's the same card I used for the transaction (which by the way they've already taken the money from my account) he was like "oh my God" as if I was stupid or something. I think their staff need some training on customer service.

records.title: Afro international is a great company…
records.text: Afro international is a great company to do financial transactions with, but the big problem of the company is that, no provision ever made for senders to be able to edit any mistakes made during sending money.  Such as editing the address, and name of recipients except sender has to call customer service for editing which its takes longer to go through.  Please as a long time serving customers, take my experience in to consideration. Thank you all.

records.title: It's is great using Afro international
records.text: It's is great using Afro international, quick and easy to send with good rate.For Afro international to attract more customers money should be picked up from any Afro international pay points all around the country, the code should be universal just as all the other major money transfer companies do. With your pin number one should be able collect from any Afro international pay points in the country.

records.title: The transaction took too long to be…
records.text: The transaction took too long to be paid out as there was a lot of to and fro-ing regarding documents required. It could be better if customers are initially made aware that a photo ID of the sender is required before their transaction can be approved.

records.title: I have been a valid customer for a very…
records.text: I have been a valid customer for a very long time but I keep having hard time dealing with your service.  Am struggling and I need important.

records.title: I do not like the fact about you waiting or delaying service as it was for an emergency purpose …
records.text: I do not like the fact about you took my money and refuse to hand in to the receiver only for me to phone and i was told to upload my proof of identity which I don't have problem doing but before all that process, you should have let me know before.That money was urgent as it was intended for an emergency medical purpose.

records.title: The rate is good and service is ok but…
records.text: The rate is good and service is ok but sometimes you frustrate customers by stopping them to send money and you request for bank details. I'm risking to send my bank details. I see you updated your system which is good.

records.title: The app is not consistent
records.text: The app is not consistent; on some days it just doesn’t work when I want to remit money urgently. The owners must improve or upgrade the app to make it reliable and faster.

records.title: Customer service numbers poor customer service
records.text: Customer service numbers. Tried call the USA and UK numbers so many times. No answer. Phone just rang and hanged up. Not even an answering service.

records.title: I don’t think I have to keep repeating…
records.text: I don’t think I have to keep repeating myself but unfortunately it has to be this way

records.title: They cannot send big amount like up to…
records.text: They cannot send big amount like up to £3,000 without lots of hassle. It has caused serious and unrepairable damage because my money cannot go on time. Otherwise £1000 and less is ok.

records.title: They ask you for id and bank statement…
records.text: They ask you for id and bank statement to verify transfer after you have already paid your money to them. They should ask you all of this info before even letting you pay your money. It’s very annoying. Other transfer companies are satisfied with only a driver license or passport to verify identity. It’s really a inconvenience to both me and the person receiving money. I wish this company could change that.

records.title: I am frustrated that the system kept…
records.text: I am frustrated that the system kept telling me that my password or email details were wrong. I have been using the app for years now but for several months now I haven't been able to use the app. Each time I visit I have to chose a new password. Furthermore, after my last 2 reviews I was offered discounts but never received them. Not happy.

records.title: Poor experience and customer service
records.text: After the money transfer went through, the money was withheld. they requested bank statement, payslip and Passport from me before the money would paid. I was treated like a criminal. That's not all too long to explain

records.title: I sent money to myself from London
records.text: I sent money to myself from London. Money was removed from my London account. I tried to collect money in Freetown but was told money could not be paid. I was told to complain. I called office in Freetown. No help. I am left stranded with no money in Freetown.

records.title: I have been trying  to send  money  but…
records.text: I have been trying  to send  money  but  always  been  declined. It has been written  that I  have exceeded my  limits  even though I have  not sent a single cent  that money . All this  happens  when I sent money  and some  one withdrawn the money  and I  didn't get any support from you  people.
