Do since  then  if even  I wanted to  send  £100 I'm  mostly  been  declined

records.title: Unreasonable treatment
records.text: You made me send not just the standard requisite proof of ID but an additional selfie photograph with the camera held very close to my face, which I did, and that was still not enough for operatives who demanded another photo shot with my BRP ID held next to my face.  I dismissed the latter and requested an immediate refund of my money or a release of the same to my beneficiary. You failed to execute my instructions correctly and promptly yesterday. Your treatment is unacceptable.

records.title: Total shambles that caused unnecessary…
records.text: Total shambles that caused unnecessary delays. The initial registration and approval of the transfer was excellent. However, the verification of the ID and how that is communicated is what caused the shambles. The only reason I’ve given them 2* is because an IT specialist intervened and the matter was resolved.

records.title: Unable to reach your representative on…
records.text: Unable to reach your representative on phone after several attempts as I was asked to call in order for my transaction to complete. I ended up using another method to send the money.

records.title: I gave two stars because you can’t use…
records.text: I gave two stars because you can’t use debit card  for direct payment payment except you use GPay or Apple Pay. That’s sucks!!!!

description: Turn your buys into highs! Join 4 million members who are making their mobile bills drop just by elevating their spending habits. Connect your cards, shop with over 200 well loved brands, cash in your rewards and boost your mobile life 🚀

records.title: Easy to make a purchase and get airtime…
records.text: Easy to make a purchase and get airtime credit in your account. The best feature is being able to buy gift cards and get money back towards my airtimeAny problems I've had is easily rectified with a quick chat via the online form.

records.title: Definitely worth it
records.text: 100% recommend to anyone it saves a fortune off your phone bill. You’ll save some cash that would’ve been spent on you phone bill. Definitely worth it.

records.title: Like it as no effort to earn money.done…
records.text: Like it as no effort to earn money.done need to activate any offer or click on link and buying trough them. Now they asking. Would great if Morrisons I store purchase would included

records.title: A wonderful platform
records.text: A wonderful platform. It allows me to earn cashbacks on purchases with my credit and debit card. I was able to redeem my rewards to my O2 account to cover part of my monthly payment.

records.title: Easy money saving!
records.text: Great way to benefit from everyday spending and save money on your mobile bill. Easy to use app. Reward activity is accurately recorded and easily tracked 🙂👍🏽

records.title: Great to receive cash back on items you…
records.text: Great to receive cash back on items you were going to buy anyway. Could maybe do with adding a few more popular places to shop but otherwise very happy.

records.title: Highly recommended- Great app
records.text: Very easy to use. When I had to be in touch with them responses have been swift and professional. Highly recommended

records.title: Totally effortless experience
records.text: Totally effortless experience. I can sit back and spend without having to worry if I’ve claimed my cashback. The cashback deals can sometimes make it worth going for more expensive retailers knowing that I will get money back off my phone bill. I also enjoy the monthly challenges to get extra money too!

records.title: Spend as normal and earn cash
records.text: What's not to like just spend on linked cards at participating retailers and earn money off your phone bill. Some of the offers are really good just check the app for the current offers

records.title: I love this App
records.text: I love this App, most of the time I forget about it until they send an email reminding me 😃 I save it then for December phone bill

records.title: Earn Airtime without effort
records.text: Great app. Earn rewards without even thinking about it. Would be better if you could redeem in increments of £5 rather than £10.

records.title: Good way to save on mobile bills.A few…
records.text: Good way to save on mobile bills.A few extra retailers such as Tesco and M+S would be a great addition.

records.title: The process works but!
records.text: The process works, but I do not understand why Airtime needs account details to be able to join Ignite. Another risk of having your account details compromised.

records.title: Lots of opportunity to lower your mobile bill!
records.text: Great scheme with lots of retailers to shop with and earn cash back, could do better with Chase cards as they differ to other cards, so you have to claim rather than it being automated, however its worth it! Keep up the good work Airtime team

records.title: Easy to get savings on my account
records.text: Easy to get savings on my account

records.title: This is an easy to use app which costs…
records.text: This is an easy to use app which costs nothing and saves you money. My only disappointment is that most of the shops I use (Waitrose, John Lewis, LNER etc) have disappeared recently, apparently  in favour of niche outlets. Please bring them back.

records.title: Overall getting money back for nothing…
records.text: Overall getting money back for nothing is always great and Airtime offers this. The down side in my experience are, retailers only accepting certain credit cards and changing these randomly it seems. Retailers vanishing from your lists when you have used them several times before a then appearing a few days later.

records.title: OK but would like more shops I use
records.text: It is OK and I suppose it is money for nothing, but personally I don’t use many of the shops that are included, and just as I found one I might use regularly it withdrew! That and the sometimes long lead times before you get the bonus means it took me something like 6 months to get £20. But I suppose it was £20 for nothing. And having to remember not to use an Amex card is a bit of a nuisance.

records.title: I wish more big retailers were involved
records.text: I love getting money off my phone bill. However, I wish supermarkets such as Tesco or Sainsbury's were involved, as I often only really get money back for using  Boots. Also, I wish you didn't have to wait to have £10 reward before you can redeem your reward. There are some months when I can't redeem my rewards at all

records.title: Easy to use app
records.text: Easy to use app. Have to keep on top of which retailers are included, as the grocery ones in particular change often. Some receipts don't appear, but the process of challenging this is relatively easy, as long as you have the paper receipts to scan. Updating the registered cards was easy, but takes a bit of time to become 'active'. The cash pot builds up quickly once you get going.

records.title: Really easy to use and have saved £40…
records.text: Really easy to use and have saved £40 this year on my mobile phone bills ..definitely worth having and would recommend it Wondering why though some of your retail partners have such a long time from buying with them  to the money being in my rewards account - 80 days compared to some with just over 30 days seems a bit too long ..be great if these could be shortened ?

records.title: Good way to earn some extra cash
records.text: Good way to earn some extra cash though there are quite a few issues with the way it works. - the time it takes for funds to clear is very long. - You can only withdraw in multiples of £5 which makes some rewards accumulated quite pointless and you lose the balance if not enough rewards are earned to be able to withdraw- you could withdraw to your bank account before but that is not possible anymore which is annoying

records.title: More Everyday Partners Such As Asda??…
records.text: It's good that you get airtime rewards however I would like to raise 2 points. The majority of the reward partners are obscure companies that I don't use. It would be nice if they could partner with everyday supermarkets such as Asda. Also why are transitions with Deliveroo pending for 85 days,  can they not be 35 days like Boots for example?

records.title: Really great way to make savings on…
records.text: Really great way to make savings on your monthly phone bill.I have had a few issues with rewards not being added but this has been resolved with a quick message to the customer service team who have been really great with sorting these issues out.Overall well worth signing up and also sign up to ignite as you can get your rewards alot quick from certain retailers.

records.title: Easy to accrue and redeem awards simply…
records.text: Easy to accrue and redeem awards simply by signing up and shopping as normal. Quite a wide range of retailers but could always add more. Feels good reducing my phone bill by using rewards that I gained as an added extra to my shopping.

records.title: It's great that I can just shop and get…
records.text: It's great that I can just shop and get points added to my airtime rewards without having to do anything else. I wish there were more retailers involved, although looking at someone else's review Sainsbury's is involved, but I never get points from shopping there and I'm there every week! It can take a while to build up points, because I won't purposefully go to the shops linked to airtime and alot of the time I'll miss out on the monthly bonus because I haven't been shopping at those outlets. But it is a nice bonus when it does all add up and I can take £10 off my bill here and there. I've been using this app for about a year or so and I have reduced my bill 5 times ish.

records.title: Good little money saver app
records.text: Does what it says it does. Easy to use. Slow to build up points for everyday purchases, but definitely useful for occasional big purchases from John Lewis and the like. Good that it's basically set and forget.A couple of improvements that I hope will happen at some point:1. Doesn't track AMEX cards currently2. The tracking on the monthly challenges seems pretty hit and miss.3. More supermarkets on the system would be appreciated. Morrisons and Tesco are my locals and aren't covered

records.title: Saved me money on my phone bills
records.text: Save quite a bit off my phone bill this year. The scheme is very good. However, there can be long pending periods and often with flash events the additional rewards are not always added automatically. However, customer services are usually quite quick to respond and will add any missed rewards very quickly.

records.title: Love this app
records.text: Love this app! ...but,there have been issues missing on quite e few purchases during Xmas and NY times, unfortunately i didn't keep receipts and couldn't report them all missing. Otherwise,happy to have money offy phone bill 😊

records.title: Great scheme but some annoying factors…
records.text: Great way to save money on my phone bill. Have saved almost £100 since I joined. Couple of annoying things though. Spent a lot of money in Crew store recently but rewards only on online purchases. Legoland rewards take months to come through with Argos and Clarins really slow as well.

records.title: Only one let down
records.text: Love the app, the idea and how it all works apart from you can only redeem or gift to someone else £10 or more.This is a shame as both my wife and I use the app and we can't share OUT rewards.Let's hope more businesses sign upto the idea.Reply.....It's.hard to reach £10 before the expiry date sometimes as there arnt too many participants unfortunately, it's even harder when as my wife uses airtime.too.   maybe we should be allowed to share an account

records.title: No Curve Cards :(
records.text: Would be 5* if they brought back Curve card compatibility. Worked flawlessly when it was an option

records.title: Not so good now
records.text: Rewards were great a few months ago but recently all the shops i used seem to be no longer available. You’ve lost Waitrose, John Lewis, Clairins to name a few. Now of the retailers I used only Boots remain. Disappointing really, especially as the app and principle of the product is good.

records.title: The rewards were great 6 months ago
records.text: The rewards were great 6 months ago, disappointed there are not as many retailers listed and some such as Waitrose were only part of the scheme for a short time. Not receiving as many rewards, which is a shame.

records.title: Initially I thought this was great
records.text: Initially I thought this was great, and I saved at least £10-15 a month on my mobile bills. But I was very disappointed when Waitrose and John Lewis was no longer participating as these provided most of my savings.However, the idea is sound, if you shop regularly at some of the stores listed, it can provide good returns on the app.

records.title: Not happy!
records.text: My review a month ago would have been 5*. Wonderful to get £10 off my phone bill. Now it is 3* and that’s being generous!  My main grocery outlet is Waitrose which seems no longer to appear on your list of food/grocery outlets. I have trawled your current lists of retailers and bar Boots, Argos and Morrisons, I do not use other ones on your list. I suspect that unless I see a broader more realistic choice of useful retailers in the future, sadly I shall not benefit from being part of this scheme and you will lose a member.

records.title: I like the rewards
records.text: I like the rewards, getting rewarded for spending money and then get money off your mobile bill is a great marketing strategy. However I don’t think it works for VOXI although they belong to vodafone, as I just redeemed £10 worth of rewards towards my bill and I don’t think it worked.

records.title: Good but missing transactions are hassle to resolve
records.text: There is a few good cashback offer, but not catering or tailored to individuals so i only end up shopping at the same stores. The really big issues is missing transactions. Not happy that I have wait 14 days, when airtime know if will be still a missing transaction. Really with technology  we should only wait 3 days then report a missing transaction with the receipt proof instead wasting time. As more time wasting when you do report it after 14 days and waiting more days not receiving a response  from airtime and having waste more time with messages.If they can listen to users and improve the service, it would be much better

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Everything was fine until the beginning of June but the transaction I made in Waitrose on 12 June still has not appeared on Airtime.  Today I filled in the Missing Transaction form with all the relevant info, including a photo of the till receipt but was unable to submit the form.  There were two or three other transactions which also did not appear but unfortunately I don’t have the till receipts.

records.title: Improvement Needed
records.text: I found this very good at first with new retailers added regularly with notifications on the APP. More recently the retailers I used frequently (Waitrose, Aldi etc) have been removed with no notification that this has been done. Should let us know not just when retailers added but also when removed so that we can shop to maximise benefits. Why are retailers being removed?

records.title: Disappointed with recent list of retailers
records.text: Initially I saved up quite a lot of credit to use to reduce my phone bill, but in recent months Waitrose was removed from the Airtime lists. As I mainly shop there and at Tesco, I’ve gained nothing. Disappointed.

records.title: Improvements need to be made regarding updating accurate rewards
records.text: Was great at first with the rewards being added, however recently they are getting quite poor at updating/ acknowledging the rewards.So have to chase up with further emails/ missing transactions. Not always getting dealt with properly/promptly. Boots seems to be problematic 2-3 times now have failed to update automatically. It's a bit of a pain having to chase it up.Also gift card purchases, if buying multiples on the same day more frequently now they are not all being updated. Meaning that you constantly have to keep checking and getting in touch. Really could do with improving the system as like I said it has recently gone down hill.

records.title: Can’t redeem rewards….
records.text: For a few weeks now I have been trying to redeem £20 worth of rewards to my O2 account. In spite of several exchanges with both Airtime and O2 my attempts to redeem always show as ‘unavailable’. Airtime have made a £10 goodwill addition to my rewards but I still can’t redeem it! Catch 22! I requested a bank transfer or cheque in lieu but Airtime only refund to PayPal. I don’t do PayPal so I’ve given up. Anyone on O2 hoping to redeem beware!!!

records.title: Great concept but the ‘ignite’…
records.text: Great concept but the ‘ignite’ ‘membership’ is really bad, I’ve raised so many missing transactions it’s becoming a joke. The only ones that track are EE direct debits. I’ve been told that because ignite is new it’s prone to errors- then either don’t release, or recall the product.

records.title: As far as loyalty/rewards schemes go
records.text: As far as loyalty/rewards schemes go, it's OK. I can't say more than that. There are worse schemes around. It's really useful if you're a regular customer of the services and shops with which the scheme has partnership deals but it hasn't been particularly worthwhile for me.

records.title: Waiting time for rewards is too long
records.text: Good reward system but it would be better and worthy of 5 stars if you give the reward within 7 days for all retailers and 3 days for giftcards. Currently I’m reluctant to spend on other sites because it takes month or so to get rewards. Please reduce waiting days for rewards especially for giftcards!Thanks

records.title: Not a fairytale
records.text: When I signed up, the idea of getting money off my phone bill by just shopping seemed too good to be true. It was. At first, you could get money back from grocery shopping at Aldi, Waitrose or Tesco.  These disappeared  within a few weeks of signing up,and now the only places you seem to be able to get money back from are stores no-one is likely to use on a regular basis. I'll keep it for now, as I will occasionally be using some of these stores,  but it's not the fairytale it first looked like.

records.title: It's probably great if you regularly…
records.text: It's probably great if you regularly buy stuff from the partner stores, but I don't so I just found it annoying to have the app cluttering up my phone. Took a long time (at least 6 months if not longer) for me to get to the minimum £10 for withdrawal so I deleted the app after that.

records.title: Definitely worth trying
records.text: I would say great to use as anything to help pay a mobile bill is definitely worth it. Just to be mindful that transactions can take 85 days to clear depending on retailer, so it’s not always quick and you have to make your first £10 before you can deduct from any bill, so process for me is too slow. Some Food retailers should be instant because you cant return food once it’s been consumed in a restaurant, so definitely feel there needs some improvements to make this much faster.

records.title: Could be improved to help the high street
records.text: Great idea if only I shopped mostly on line. High street stores would benefit me more. Also some rewards get forgotten, I should have had February 6 spends rewarded with a bonus of £1.50 so far not been added.

records.title: Starts well, but soon changes
records.text: Was very happy with airtime until they changed most of the apps where I was receiving rewards, since then nothing since July. Seems a case of if your getting too many discounts, let's stop that happening

records.title: Not sure it’s worth it!
records.text: I’m finding Airtime difficult to use. The participating companies are not ones I can shop at easily or would normally consider. It takes me many months to get anywhere near the required £10 and the length of time rewards take to be credited to my Airtime account seems very long.

records.title: I'm sorry to say that again Airtime…
records.text: I'm sorry to say that again Airtime rewards have let me down. My voucher purchases did not track, nor my Aldi puechases. When I complained that they hadn't tracked and therefore I didn't get my stamps for my monthly challenge, they have added my stamps (than you) but not the actual rewards for the individual purchases so I'm over £2 short. Ok it's not a fortune but you shouldn't have to continually check to see if transactions have tracked. Been worse since the app makeover. When it works it's good, when it doesn't, it's frustrating and more stress than not bothering at all.

records.title: It's ok airtime rewards but do not refund when something wrong
records.text: I enjoyed airtime rewards app however they do not work professional and they ignorant when something wrong one you paid they will not refund even that they do not ptovide temrs and conditions. (there is a empty page temrs and conditions when you purchased gift carda) . I get a lot o discount from my phone bill. However they have a one big issue. They selling gift card without providing terms and conditions. You do not know what gift card cover. And they declining refund however mu case is still in progress and I'm pretty sure I will win it. Now I will need to get support from ombudsman legal team.

records.title: Tried to add details via a request link…
records.text: Tried to add details via a request link but didn't work. Had 3x £10 vouchers purchased 21st September and 2x £10 vouchers purchased 27th September. Also 2 purchases at Aldi for £6.38 and £5.59 both on 19th September. Hope this gets to whoever needs to see it.

records.title: Rewarding.....when it works!
records.text: Great idea and rewarding but takes time and effort to keep in check. Always getting missing transactions I have to chase up and last few months on my monthly challenge to get extra bonuses for purchases made, even though in my transactions they are there, they do not get added to the challenge without me complaining. This is something I feel I shouldn't be having to do, I should be able to trust airtime rewards to do what they promise. Needs the system improving. My wife has the same problem as you can see from her review.

records.title: Stopped tracking purchases
records.text: Not sure what is happening, but was using Ocado, and suddenly around Dec '22 it stopped tracking payments to Ocado, so no credit added to account. 4 purchases per month spending around £7-900/month.BUT any refunds from Ocado were tracked, and because of that, it deducted from my account.If it's tracking refunds from Ocado, why isn't it also tracking purchases from Ocado.Contacted support. No response so far, but will update review if they do/don't respond.

records.title: Unsatisfactory customer service.
records.text: Since they updated their app the airtime website will not let me log in.  Firstly it asks for my mobile number then asks me to enter my name, DOB, gender and postcode.  It then tells me that there is already someone with the same details and gives me an error screen.  I cannot get access to my airtime account and it is ridiculous as to the time it is taking to fix this problem.  I have emailed them many times but have had no response to my problem.  Poor customer service.

records.title: Downhill
records.text: Airtime Rewards used to be a fantastic way to save on your phone bill. Now? It’s takes TOO long for transactions to track. And, for the past 2 months, O2 tracks have failed. Airtime say they’re working on it, but it’s still the same. And I’m not the only customer to notice. It’s very, very disappointing, specially as you end up not completing challenges because yet again things haven’t tracked. And the retailers…I don’t understand why MORE popular ones are yet to be added!! Get it together, Airtime! I want to see HMV, Amazon, and all the supermarkets re-added. It’s what us, the customer, wants.

records.title: Obscure shops and brands
records.text: It would be a great idea if the participating shops and companies weren’t so obscure. There are only one retailer I shop in on a regular basis. It’s also very disappointing to think you’ve earned some money on a purchase only to find out that retailer has suddenly dropped out, which happened to me today. It’s a great concept, but I fail to see how anyone can save any significant money unless they’re going to Legoland Windsor and on the London Eye every week.

records.title: Visited Leicester clock tower branch…

records.title: A manager that's a fool
records.text: My local bank has a manager that's an incompetent fool, fortunately the people on the counter know how to do the job better and I was able to open a savings account and shown how to use it. Avoid dealing with the Trowbridge (Wiltshire) manager if you can, most of the other staff members are brilliant. The APP works well and is laid out well and is easy to use and understand.

records.title: HSBC ON BNS SAVER
records.text: My experience with the HSBC ON BNS Saver savings account was excellent, and it quickly became my preferred online savings option. A key highlight was the 4% interest rate. While many banks drastically reduced their rates, HSBC maintained this high rate, which appeals to savers like myself.However, I recently learned that HSBC plans to reduce the interest rate. Given that the 4% rate is still available, I’m taking advantage of it. It feels like a smart move to make the most of this opportunity before the rate changes!

records.title: Online customer service is great
records.text: Timely support from Kayleigh via advisory chat. Thank you

records.title: Current account basic
records.text: As my habitat / residing is overseas in Europe, it is rather easy as a Dutchman in the Netherlands, to open online a basic current account at HSBC UK. Great! Most British banks will refuse, as you have to reside in the UK for a bank account but this bank thinks internationally.

records.title: I was horrified to discover an…
records.text: I was horrified to discover an unauthorised direct debit on my church's bank account today.   I'm the treasurer.   We don't ever use direct debits on the bank account in question.   However, I telephoned the fraud department on the number shown on HSBC website, and Dhruvin cancelled it efficiently and politely.      It is very scary that a fraudster could so easily set up a direct debit on our account.  Perhaps HSBC needs to review what information it requires when setting up direct debits.   Our church has a rule that any two of four signatories must authorise payments.  How could someone by-pass this?

records.title: Relaxed and enjoyable meeting at Hastings' Branch
records.text: Yesterday I met with Dan and Jane at Hastings branch to open a new account. They made the process straight forward, relaxed and informative, and, even, enjoyable. It was great to do this face to face rather than over the phone.Thank you for great service.

records.title: Helpful staff
records.text: There doesn't seem to be enough staff in the branch however, those who work there are very helpful and try their best to reduce waiting time.  Thank you very much for your assistance today.

records.title: Complaints Dept.
records.text: Had occasion to be transferred from, presumably, the overseas call centre, to the complaints dept which seemed to be UK based.  Once there, received excellent service, with a return phone call to try and sort out a difficult problem of a lost account.  They got there in the end and the agent was very thorough, courteous and efficient.  I was surprised by an offer of "a gesture of goodwill" to be paid into my account.  And I don't even bank with HSBC! So it's not all bad.

records.title: Failed to exchange old banknotes
records.text: Found some old banknotes, wanted to exchange at HSBC in Catford as it was my nearest branch and have been told to go to Bromley branch; not exactly a modern approach. In the end just turned at NatWest next door for help. Embarrassing way to solve an issue, but saved me some time

records.title: Thank you, HSBC!
records.text: I lost my debit card on Monday, August 14 and reported this and applied for a new card on the same day via the phone app. I wanted to transfer funds to another bank acct. (not HSBC) but kept receiving the error message saying payee details could not be confirmed. Popped into the Camden town branch and the extremely helpful team member organised the transfer for me and confirmed the new card was in my Apple Wallet. Received a text on August 15 saying my replacement card was on its way and it arrived safely next day! Banks receive such bad press, but HSBC has always been professional and if anything goes wrong, very speedy at fixing the problem. I just hope they continue to keep local branches open... the missing star was due to lack of clarity during a phone call re card replacement.

records.title: Noticeable Improvement!
records.text: Recently had trouble with re-setting up my mobile banking app after having to restore my phone. Also required assistance with clearing an old credit card I’d left closed & in default for two years.Called customer services on both occasions and there was zero wait time & the operators were incredibly helpful and polite.I’ve been with HSBC for 17 years and found the telephone service to be such a huge step up, I decided to leave a positive review. After all, very rarely does anyone come on a review site to do anything but vent their anger & frustration..4/5. Solely because I had to Google the customer services number, as you still seem to do your best to keep your telephone numbers buried beneath dead-end automated help pages.

records.title: HSBC Redeems Itself
records.text: Update 3.After going through the formal complaint, HSBC has redeemed itself. Given the initial problem I can't give a 5 star. But I can certainly give a 4 star review.

records.title: Initially attracted by the Martin Lewis…
records.text: Initially attracted by the Martin Lewis information, but was interested in their currency card, although Ive not got as far as that yet!Opening account is fine, a lot of emails and letters but ok. Transferring money in to the current account is easy, as is spending it. However, trying to get some of it back out (into the same source account)....oh dear. A fraud text, three phone calls, 5 different operators. Strangest questions, I appreciate a level of security but this was another level, I actually thought I had dialled a scam number and they were phishing for information........................................................Update, after 9 months I have found the currency card to be extremely useful. Several trips to Euro and non Euro countries have been made much easier with the card.

records.title: Dumfries Branch
records.text: I joined the bank as a customer 6 months ago. I only have savings accounts so not much can go wrong. The Dumfries branch were helpful and pleasant.

records.title: Good
records.text: They are a good bank, the app is great but sadly in Northern Ireland there is now only one physical branch open! Opening an account with them online is a breeze but you may still need to go into a physical branch to provide a signature and apply for savings accounts

records.title: Great amenities but reduction in physical locations is getting tedious
records.text: I like HSBC as they have the global currency card, that’s great. But unfortunately the branches are getting more and more sparse, it’s important for banks to keep these open. Otherwise, great bank.

records.title: I lost access to my mobile banking…
records.text: I lost access to my mobile banking after switching to a new phone.Without my security log in details I called through to the telephone banking it was a straight forward process, the agent handled the call with patience as technology isn't something I deal with often. This is one of the only times I've had to contact with any issue and although I should have kept me phone to switch over my mobile banking it was a smooth process - the wait times on the phones could have been a bit quicker!

records.title: Day-to-Day = rubbish, but when it counted, they really delivered.
records.text: 0% Interest on current account, which is rubbish, but I had an issue with eDreams and they took my complaint seriously, and got me my money back.  So in short; day-to-day  they're pretty rubbish, but when it counts, they had my back.  Thank you!

records.title: I am an immigrant and i have my account…
records.text: I am an immigrant and i have my account opened in HSBC bank without any hustle and obstacles. I was assisted by Ewelina Kuster. She was such a heartwarming person who guided me with every single step be it filling the form or depositing money or to learn how to change pin. I am very thankful for their cooperation. I would really like to recommend HSBC bank. And a big thanks to Ewelina. Much love❤️❤️

records.title: Formal Complaint Regarding Unprofessional Customer Service
records.text: Subject: Formal Complaint Regarding Unprofessional Customer ServiceDear  HSBC Ipswich I am writing to formally express my disappointment with the way I was treated by one of your staff members, Phil, during my visit to your branch on December 30, 2024. The incident left me feeling upset and disrespected, and I believe it highlights a need for better training on how to handle sensitive situations.To provide context, my husband, Patrick, has entrusted me with managing his financial affairs due to his health challenges over the past five years. Despite my encouragement for him to handle these matters directly, he has requested that I speak on his behalf as he finds it difficult to process such discussions.During my visit, Phil asked Patrick about the nature of certain transactions. When I explained the situation and answered his questions, he repeatedly avoided making eye contact with me and directed his responses to my husband instead. When I encouraged him to speak with Patrick directly, his reply, “but you’re the one talking and not Patrick, is it,” felt dismissive and unprofessional. Phil then took Patrick aside for a private conversation, leaving me feeling excluded and undervalued despite my genuine efforts to provide clear and honest information.While I understand that it is the bank’s responsibility to safeguard its customers, I believe the situation could have been handled with far greater sensitivity and professionalism. Managing my husband’s finances is already a challenging and emotionally taxing responsibility, and this experience added unnecessary stress to an already difficult situation.For 15 years, I have been financially independent, and stepping into this role was a decision made out of necessity due to my husband’s health. I am deeply committed to ensuring his well-being, and I expected your staff to show understanding and empathy during this interaction.I hope you will take this feedback seriously and provide training for your team to better handle similar situations in the future. Customers managing financial matters on behalf of loved ones often face unique challenges and deserve to be treated with dignity and respect.Thank you for taking the time to address this matter. I look forward to your response and to hearing how you plan to prevent similar experiences for other customers.Sincerely,Pamela Naylor

records.title: Global Money incompetence
records.text: Update: HSBC complaint team have contacted me and handled the issue very well, so I've moved from 1 to 3 stars.Global Money:  transactions from a recent trip to italy are not managed correctly, resulting in a false "debit".  The "hold" created by suppliers (car rental, petrol pumps) is not removed while the actual transaction is completed.  Transactions info is not available to remediate this, and help is very poor.  Also, the app is also very poor.

records.title: Removed bank managers for small business and increased overdraft arrangement fee (annually
records.text: its a real shame you have removed bank managers for small business. now you are a faceless bank, computer and ai driven. i was never told you would increase the cost of an overdraft for my account that i have had for about 20 years and really you should reduce this since you have no account managers. no letters telling us about the fee, i just had to work out what the £450 fee was.  then you make be update my records and threaten to close my account if not completed in time when you should be paying me for my time to compliance you with your FSA .  so it seems its time to move to a more modern bank since i have no loans, all i have is the covid loan. almost paid off.

records.title: Be aware.HSBC charge a cash advance fee…
records.text: Be aware.HSBC charge a cash advance fee when foreign currency “holiday money” is purchased using their credit card from Post Office, Tesco etc etc.It is part of their credit card rules.Always use debit card for such purchases.

records.title: HSBC Uxbridge
records.text: Arrived at the bank, all staff busy attending customer's. I finally made eye contact with the staff young Asian chap. Managed to sort the banking issue but seemed stressed out but no smile or any form of communication. I appreciate you're help said to him. No response!

records.title: So never had a problem with the bank…
records.text: So never had a problem with the bank has far has customer service but they claim to wanna help people with the cost of living over draft but not if you have a basic bank account. And that’s the people that need the most help yet it doesn’t qualify. I work just has hard to put money into my account has anyone with a higher bank account but always seem to get over looked with discrimination. Looks like hsbc is yet another bank that thinks the minimum wage works are not the ones who qualify for much.

records.title: Would avoid
records.text: Never really had much of an issue with HSBC , only 3 stars since their branches are now kind of pointless . What’s the point in having a bank branch if you cannot accept coins / have a cash desk you rely on the cash machines to take the money to deposit so if u have a note that’s damaged or folded loads you just get told to go post office . Most banks now have a little area for cash deposits or them machines that eat the change to be deposited but why have a ‘ cashless bank branch ‘ ? To interact with staff to get additional services , help with app or account is good . But if someone looses their card and needs cash well good luck getting it from the local branch .

records.title: Mobile app load of cra?
records.text: Updated to an iPhone and download the HSBC app only to find what you cannot do is update payees. How can you visit a branch when they are all miles away do we have to move to China? Sadly my local RBS also closed along with eight others in Prestatyn. Not much choice for banking nowadays and Principality doesn’t do current accounts. Looks like a car trip instead of a few minutes on a computer. Finally managed my payees so upgraded my rating

records.title: Terrible customer service
records.text: Terrible customer service, don’t bother! Live chat assistance is a robot and then moves to a human, who doesn’t care, isn’t helpful, ignores questions, refuses to give a complaint email, then closes the chat whilst I am typing. Ruby requires much more customer service training! AVOID

records.title: Nothing offer really for loyal customers
records.text: I had been with HSBC for more than 18 years. I do not have complain about customer service as I always got the support from them whenever I called them or visited the branch. Recently I decided to switch as they never offered any benefits for my savings. Their interest rate has always been low. When I tried to get personal loan, I was refused to get that though my salary used to come to that account for years. Hence I decided to switch. Otherwise I was happy with their security protocols and felt safe having account with them.

records.title: Global money is great, rest is poor/uncompetitive.
records.text: Global money is great. Current account is good. Investment platform is a joke (bad and high cost). Customer service is a roll of dice, sometimes good sometimes useless. Just open an account for the global money card and do the rest of your banking elsewhere.

records.title: Good basic banking service
records.text: Been a business customer for over 13 years and as a basic banking service there have been no problems. Always been in credit. We do not use the over the counter service and the online portal does have user issues. Not one person has ever spoken to us in all the time we have been a customer.

records.title: Online banking set up delay
records.text: Got a credit card, 0% interest on purchases for 22 months, so far so good.However, to be able to manage any card of any type we obviously need online banking set up, and herein lies the problem. After 2 phone calls and a promise they have posted the required telephone banking details to enable me to set up online banking, I’m still waiting for the post with the details! But then if they used Royal Mail, I could be in for a long wait.Update: a third phone call and they were able to fully complete and verify my setup through to completion over the phone. The app is a bit of overkill considering I only have a credit card (it covers all their accounts).It works for verifying card purchases as it should, but one limitation is that it doesn't list pending transactions! So a purchase (on the credit card at least) only appears in the app once the merchant has fully completed the transaction.

records.title: Could be good branches but too busy and not enough
records.text: The actual manchester branches are quite good in terms of what you can do there. The problem is there is so few of them so the central one I went to is so busy as everyone goes there and as a result the service falters. Really large queues, feel really rushed. Alternative is to improve app continuously so don't need to come in

records.title: Good Branch service - don't bother trying to call them
records.text: I had a lot interaction with HSBC when I managed   my now deceased Mum's account via a Power of Attorney. I found the staff in my local branch in Romford Market Place to be both available and helpful; they were also very friendly and understanding.There were occasions when the branch was busy and I had to wait, or when the staff member couldn't help with my problem and had to seek advice but, I have nothing but thanks for them.However, I'm sure that most of the questions I had and actions I needed to take could have been achieved over the phone and online rather than the several Branch visits I had to make.I cannot give my review more than 3 stars because HSBC simply do not answer their phones, and their online banking app lacks decent features.I called HSBC so may times. More than once I waited over 30 minutes. I never spoke to a human over the phone. Never.I cannot recommend HSBC and am thankful that I don't have an account with them

records.title: Mixed experiences of customer service
records.text: Firstly, the bad news. My wife and I have been Premier customers for a very long time, and used to think HSBC was at least a 4star bank. However, now HSBC have withdrawn the live chat function from desktop online banking, you just get a chatbot which is worse than useless,  apparently you have to go on to their banking app on your mobile to reach this facility. Now I don't want banking on my mobile phone, I am liable to forget to take it with me and what if it is lost or stolen? So if I or my wife want to deal with a human which happened recently we have to ring up, go through multiple choice menus and recorded messages at length and even  then no human wants to speak to you. The operative we eventually got to speak to promised to deal with the issue (frozen ISA account) but didn't. We went to our nearest branch (York) to see if they could sort the problem but they could only tell us to ring up! Going round in circles here. This one is still pending.Now the good news, when we had to sort out the finances of a dead relative, the branch in York did have an operative to deal with that which was done effectively. Edit 23rd Oct: After posting this review, and getting in touch with HSBC "Social Media" we finally got the ISA issue sorted. We had to go back to York to the branch (which was unbeknownst to us shut for refurb) and see a member of HSBC staff in the Hilton Hotel, who at last sorted the problem out. Apparently if you don't put money in a cash ISA for a full tax year it is frozen. Who knew? It is not exactly publicised. So a hassle to sort out a simple issue. Not shining Customer Service HSBC!

records.title: Just so, so slow!
records.text: Had a MyAccount and MySavings for my child. Advisors themselves we’re really friendly, although everything was so slow! When trying to open account in-branch, took about 45 minutes which is much longer than any other bank we’ve used. App was outdated and not great to use, but not the worst either. My son has standing orders setup for funds to go from his main current account with another provider to his savings, but for this to work, he had to transfer to the MyAccount first and then to the MySavings. HSBC we’re slow at one of these transactions which resulted in him going slightly overdrawn as he didn’t use his main MyAccount. Received a slightly agressive letter saying that he might be reported to credit agencies for going £5 overdrawn! Not great and slow service.

records.title: I like the online banking but I’m…
records.text: I like the online banking but I’m pretty disappointed that the advance account advertised on the Martin Lewis show today, is not open to existing customers. On that basis I’m shutting my account!

records.title: I had a very good customer service…
records.text: I had a very good customer service experience when I called to make an enquiry. The call was answered quickly and I spoke to a young man who took time to check the information he gave me was correct and he explained things I didn't understand. I decided to apply for a bank account online the day after. Since then it hasn't been so good. I received a text to inform me my application had been received and ten days later have had no updates at all. Their website prides itself on their digital and mobile services, implying this is much faster and improved from good old counter services. I am not impressed at all. Had I gone into a bank to apply I am sure it would have been dealt with efficiently. How hard is it to send an update text so at least I know I am not forgotten, so it seems I will have to chase them up for the privilege of allowing them to have my business. I am sick of these 'improvements' that are costly and result in far inferior services. I will try elsewhere if I can even find a bank with counter service. Once upon a time ordinary didn't need to have banks, we used cash, our spending was simple and private. How stupid of us to let that go.

records.title: Poor customer service
records.text: Besides the speed of response on the chat service so far I am not happy with the service. Apparently to set-up a direct debit if you don’t have a current account with HSBC is by calling them or sending a written letter. Seems ridiculous in this day and age and all of their competitors have an online form for any current account. Awful.

records.title: Consistently poor and confusing.
records.text: I really don’t like reviewing negatively, I appreciate call agents have a tricky job with many customers calling, but I do not experience such consistently bad customer service with any other banks I’m registered with. Every single time I call I’m passed around at least 3 agents and departments. I’m currently trying to report fraud on my account, pretty simple stuff, and I’m now on hold to speak to a 6th agent. HSBC, there is only so much patience I can give. Every single time I call there is a problem. I’d rate this 1 star but at least the call agents are usually nice… if also useless.

records.title: Not a good experience
records.text: Never received a pass code to gain access to my account had to phone customer service. Also no clear instructions on how to pay your card ended up being charged a late payment fee, Had to phone customer service several times to find out.

records.title: Hard Work !!!
records.text: We have been working with various banks over the last several years and after making application to HSBC London, we have never experienced such a shambles. The of course asked many many questions over the last several months which (in our opinion) were above and beyond necessity in respect to due diligence. They referred to relatives of associates that we worked with as "credit risks" and therefore were not able to work with us ! crazy. Don't waste your time with this bank. It shouldn't be allowed to call itself a bank.

records.title: I've had issues with online ordering…
records.text: I've had issues with online ordering and the app verification process. When I am asked to verify my payment via the app, the order I placed does not go through properly. However, money has been taken from my account. I now have to chase up a refund or file a dispute. Update I will give an extra star as the dispute was dealt with very efficiently and my money was returned.

records.title: So fed up with waiting for my credit…
records.text: So fed up with waiting for my credit card replacement! This is the 3rd time it was requested by a department because previous requests were not executed?! I was told it will take 6 working days to get to the branch, it's 10 days now and still nothing. Online chat keeps timing out and every time I have to start a new one just to see another CS rep message 'I'm sorry...blah blah, I believe you are contacting us about card replacement (duh I just filled in bot's responses to say why I'm contacting you!), 'let me check it for you' - then times out (sorry, I can't sit and wait for the agent to respond). So fed up and frustrated. Used to like HSBC but something has seriously gone downhill!

records.title: Login is terrible
records.text: Login is terrible, none of your web advice is helping. You keep blocking my account, every time I try to access it you said that your app is installed on my multiple devices. It's funny how you try to limit people's choice to just one device. I have different devices and I am not using just one, but that is not a reason to block me from accessing my personal bank account to check my balance and situation. I know my logins details, my code and do on.., but I don't have time to call you for two hours to get through your customer service to reach you that is somewhere abroad and then experiencing bad hearing aids or don't not speak English.

records.title: HSBC does not help first time home…
records.text: HSBC does not help first time home buyers unless you have asked for credit according to the underwriting team. The branch also refused to set up new current account for my partner who has a basic account. He has since set up another bank account elsewhere. Unfair treatment to loyal customers.

records.title: Loan declined
records.text: Been with HSBC all my life, have my mortgage with them and always healthy funds in my account and no missed payments. They rejected a very small loan application on the grounds i didnt fit eligibility and when I called its because they didn't have on file whether i worked full time or part time! Daft. Meanwhile a hard search has been done on my credit file and they can't overturn the decision. Been told to just apply again which would mean another credit search which would impact my score so just going to save for a few months instead of going through this again with HSBC. My mortgage was easier to get than a £3k loan. Gave an extra star as the person on the phone was helpful.

records.title: Your Loss HSBC
records.text: I applied for a HSBC credit card online last week which was immediately approved. I received the card through the post, downloaded the HSBC app and activated my new card. So far so good….until today when I received a letter from HSBC stating that they had doubts that this was a genuine application and requiring me to go to a branch in person with my passport and proof of address. As HSBC have recently closed my local branch, I was not about to travel further afield to confirm my identity in person. I telephoned HSBC; the staff were perfectly polite but insistent that I should attend a branch to prove my identity. Whilst I appreciate the need to prevent fraud, there are easier ways to confirm identity in 2024 so account closed and I’ll take my custom elsewhere. Your loss HSBC.
